strengths: Since you are always in super armor state while the skill is activated, your biggest strength is that you can forcefully launch a battle without being stopped by enemy CC. weaknesses: If there is no fighting spirit (such as immediately after the start of a battle), durability will not be fully demonstrated, so the immediate defense against surprise attacks will not be high. strategy.teamfight: When teamfights erupt, Sun Yin must perform their role with flawless execution! Land your skills with pinpoint accuracy and break their will to fight!

combos.title: Core Burst Combo
combos.description: Skill 2 -> Skill 1 -> Ultimate. Use your crowd control to lock down the target, then immediately follow up with your primary damage abilities to obliterate them in seconds.

combos.title: Aggressive Poke Combo
combos.description: Skill 1 -> Basic Attack -> Skill 2. Perfect for safely chipping away at enemy health during the laning phase before committing to a full all-in.

synergy.reason: With increased mobility and silence skills, you can move around safely and deal damage.
Increased speed and recovery can increase the survivability of marksmen with low mobility.

counters.reason: Possessing high mobility and burst damage, he can instantly defeat Sun Ying, who has low durability.
He has excellent poke and mobility, and can continuously apply pressure while avoiding Sun Ying's skills.

strengths: Skill 2's movement speed buff for all allies and pseudo nullification of damage (rewind recovery) are its greatest strengths, and it boasts extremely high resistance to enemy burst damage. In addition, skill 3's wide range of silence and slow is a powerful counter-engaging ability that breaks up enemy skill combos, making it great for controlling teamfights.
weaknesses: Sun Yin himself has no hard CC (such as stun or knockup) and cannot deal instant damage, so he is completely dependent on the firepower and coordination of his allies. In a situation where your allies are not developed, your ability to overturn the game is weak. Also, skill 2's recovery is based on "damage received", so it cannot prevent instant death damage and is weak against continuous damage.

strategy.earlyGame: Baili Xuance is a high-tempo Jungle assassin who relies on snowballing. Start at your red buff and aggressively look for a Level 2 or Level 4 gank. Your entire kit revolves around landing your Skill 2 hook. If you miss the hook, disengage immediately. Focus on securing early kills to trigger your passive frenzy state.
strategy.midGame: Control the map by finding picks on isolated targets. Charge your Skill 2 in the fog of war, run in with the speed boost, and hook the enemy carry. Throw them behind you with the second cast of Skill 2, and use your Ultimate to dash through them. Your mid-game damage is lethal to squishies.
strategy.lateGame: Teamfights are extremely dangerous if you cannot secure a kill quickly. You act as an opportunistic executioner. Wait for the enemy to use their crowd control, then hook a low-health target to secure a takedown. Once an enemy dies or assists, your passive triggers, granting massive attack speed and movement speed to clean up the rest.
strategy.teamfight: Never be the first to engage. Skirt the edges of the fight charging Skill 2. Wait for a clear shot on the marksman or mage. Once hooked, drag them out of position. The absolute key to teamfighting is getting that first kill or assist to activate your Frenzy; once active, you play like a hyper-carry marksman.
strategy.commonMistakes: Missing the Skill 2 hook and committing to the fight anyway. Engaging first into a heavy CC composition, getting locked down and instantly burst before triggering your passive.

combos.title: The Over-the-Shoulder Execute
combos.description: Skill 2 (Charge & Hit) -> Skill 1 -> Skill 2 (Throw) -> Skill 3 -> Basic Attacks. Hook the target, drag them slightly with Skill 1, fling them behind you with the second cast of Skill 2, and dash through them with Ultimate while auto-attacking.

combos.title: Chase and Reposition
combos.description: Skill 1 -> Skill 2 (Charge) -> Skill 3 (If already hooked). Use Skill 1 to close the gap, immediately start charging Skill 2, and use Ultimate to reposition around a hooked target to dodge skillshots.

synergy.reason: By reliably restraining the enemy with guaranteed CC, you can ensure that Gensaku's hook combo hits.
By releasing CC and reducing damage, we will prevent Gensaku who jumps into enemy territory from being dropped by CC chain.

counters.reason: The ult instantly gives shield and damage reduction to the targeted rear guard, completely blocking Gensaku's kill.
With powerful silence and instantaneous burst damage, you can defeat Gensaku before he can connect the skill combo.

strengths: Its strengths include the restraint and forced movement (throwing) of enemies by skill 2, the high mobility and damage reduction by charging skill 3, and the overwhelming attack speed and movement speed buffs that are activated when a kill or assist is obtained. Once he creates an advantageous situation, he has the explosive power to destroy the entire enemy team.
weaknesses: Everything depends on the accuracy of skill 2, and it is a hero that requires extremely high player skill as it becomes extremely weakened when the kusarigama is removed. In addition, they are vulnerable to hard CC (stuns, etc.), and if their mobility is blocked, their fragile durability is exposed, and there is always a risk of being defeated in an instant before they can activate their passives.

strategy.earlyGame: Baili Shouyue is a lethal sniper in the Farm Lane or Mid Lane. Use your passive camouflage near walls to safely approach the lane. In the early game, your Skill 2 deals absurd damage. Hide your laser sight by aiming backwards or into a wall, then quickly flick it to the enemy for high burst damage. Dominate the lane through relentless poke.
strategy.midGame: Vision is your priority. Place your Skill 1 vision devices in crucial jungle intersections and river bushes. This makes you entirely immune to ganks. Continue to poke the enemy team under their towers with Skill 2, forcing them to recall and allowing your team to take objectives without resistance.
strategy.lateGame: Your role is to cripple the enemy carries before the teamfight even begins. A single well-aimed late-game snipe can drop an enemy mage or marksman to half HP. Use your massive basic attack damage in between snipes, as your passive converts crit chance into pure physical attack power.
strategy.teamfight: Stay far back and snipe. Do not let enemies close the gap. If an assassin dives you, immediately use your Ultimate to deal burst damage and leap backwards, slowing them. Rely on your basic attacks when enemies are too close to safely charge a snipe, as they hit incredibly hard.
strategy.commonMistakes: Over-relying on the Skill 2 snipe in close-quarters combat while ignoring your extremely high-damage basic attacks. Leaving the laser sight clearly visible for the enemy to dodge.

combos.description: Basic Attack -> Skill 3 (Ultimate) -> Skill 2. Auto-attack the diving assassin, immediately Ultimate to leap backwards and slow them, then finish them off with a quick-cast Skill 2.

synergy.reason: By stopping the enemy's movement with a long-distance stun, you can easily hit the enemy with a sniper shot.

counters.reason: Because it has a skill that nullifies physical damage, it can completely shut out the sniper damage of the guardian.
This is because the target ally will receive a shield and damage reduction with his ult, which will prevent him from killing you.

strengths: Its biggest strengths are the ability to secure up to three wide ranges of vision with skill 1, and the ultra-high firepower sniper damage from outside range with skill 2. weaknesses: Since attack speed and critical rate are converted using a special formula, they are not good at the firepower output of continuous normal attacks like regular marksmen. If you miss the sniper skill of skill 2, the damage contribution will be significantly reduced, and if you are approached by a highly mobile assassin, there is no way to counter it other than skill 3, and if you are caught, you will be extremely vulnerable.

strategy.lateGame: You are a master of teamfight orchestration. Your Ultimate creates a massive, inescapable chessboard. strategy.commonMistakes: Missing the Ultimate completely or trapping only the enemy frontline tank. Failing to consistently collide the black and white pieces, which is the primary source of your damage.

If hit, additionally reduces the target's Armor and Magic Resist by 25% (reduction over 4 seconds).
Deals 30 (30 + 25% of Magical Attack) magic damage every 0.5 seconds to enemies touched by the soul chain.
Obtain enemy vision linked to soul chains.
Passive: Increases own Armor and Magic Resist by 15%.

skill3.name: Skill 3: Taihei/Longevity
skill3.description:
After chanting for 0.75 seconds, deal true damage to the enemy linked to the ritual tool and recover HP of allies.
If the tool is linked to one target, consumes 600 HP (600 + 125% of Magical Attack) to deal the same amount of true damage to the linked enemy or restore the same amount of HP to an ally hero.
If the tool is linked to two targets, absorbs 600 HP (600 + 125% of Magical Attack) from the enemy and restores HP to allies.
If the linked target is defeated while casting, 70% of the cooldown will be returned. The HP consumed by Soul Seer will gradually recover over 5 seconds.

strengths: A specialized support that transforms a single ally into the strongest carry by greatly improving the attack performance of allies with skill 1 and instantaneous super recovery ability with skill 3. The effect of skill 2 on reducing the enemy's defense power is also powerful, and when combined with the recovery effect of the passive, it constantly raises the combat power of the accompanying allies to an overwhelming level.
weaknesses: He has almost no fighting ability or means of self-defense on his own, and cannot exert any influence at all unless he has excellent allies. Also, since there is a limit to the link distance, if you are left behind by a more mobile ally, the link will break and you will be rendered powerless. Since it does not have area crowd control, it lacks the means to stop the enemy's brute force charge.

strategy.earlyGame: Pei is an aggressive dual-form Jungle assassin/marksman. You have access to your Ultimate at Level 1, allowing you to transform between Human (ranged poke) and Tiger (melee burst). Start in Tiger form for faster clear, and aggressively invade the enemy jungle at Level 2. Your early skirmishing power is unmatched.
strategy.midGame: Control the map tempo by constantly invading and securing objectives. Use Human form to poke with Skill 1 and gain attack speed with Skill 2. When an enemy is below half health, transform into Tiger form, use Skill 2 to jump walls, and burst them down with Tiger's enhanced basic attack and Skill 1 bite.
strategy.lateGame: Late game teamfights require extreme caution as you are squishy in both forms. Play purely as a Human form marksman at the start of the fight. Poke, chip down tanks, and apply red buff slows. Only commit to Tiger form when you see a clear opportunity to clean up low-health targets.
strategy.teamfight: Stay in Human form. Spam Skill 1 to poke and Skill 2 for the shield and attack speed buff. Kite the enemy frontline. Once the enemy crowd control is exhausted and targets drop below 40% HP, press Ultimate to transform into a Tiger, leap onto the squishies with Skill 2, and execute them.
strategy.commonMistakes: Jumping into a 5v5 teamfight in Tiger form first, getting instantly focused and killed. Failing to utilize walls for the Tiger form Skill 2 double-jump mechanic.

combos.title: Tiger Cleanup Execute
combos.description: Human Skill 1 -> Skill 3 (Transform) -> Tiger Skill 2 (Wall Jump) -> Enhanced Basic Attack -> Tiger Skill 1. Poke in human form, transform to tiger, use a wall to double-jump onto the target, bite them, and finish with the execution damage.

combos.title: Human Form Kite
combos.description: Tiger Skill 3 (Transform) -> Human Skill 2 -> Basic Attacks -> Human Skill 1. Transform to human for range, pop the shield/attack speed steroid, kite backwards with basic attacks, and throw the energy blast to slow.

synergy.reason: This is because it can provide strong CC and defense buffs from the early stages and support Pei Hu's aggressive jungle invasion.
Poke from a long distance reduces the enemy's health, making it easier for Peihu to collect kills in tiger form.

counters.reason: Due to its high mobility and invincibility time, it can avoid the burst of the flying tiger, and on the other hand, it is likely to be attacked.
This is because you can significantly reduce the kill potential of Pei Hui with the health rewind and movement buff in teamfights.

passive.name: Passive skill: Dimensions
passive.description: When in human mode, the range of your normal attacks increases and you recover 5 energy each time you hit an enemy with a Basic Attack. Normal attacks deal an additional 20 magic damage, and the damage increases if you continue to attack the same target within 3 seconds (up to 3 times the base value).

forms.name: Skill 1: Fist mode
forms.description: Releases Qigong in the specified direction, dealing 275 (275 + 130% of Extra Physical Attack) magic damage and 8% of current HP magic damage to enemies along the route, and reducing enemy movement speed by 25% for 1.5 seconds. Restores 20 energy when skill 1 hits.

forms.name: Skill 1: Tiger's Roar
forms.description:
Tiger's fist bites the target enemy, dealing 300 (300 + 130% of Extra Physical Attack) physical damage. Deals an additional 1% damage for every 1% HP the target loses.
If the target enemy is defeated by this skill, Tiger's Fist will restore 20 energy.

skill1.name: Skill 1: Fist mode
skill1.description: Releases Qigong in the specified direction, dealing 275 (275 + 130% of Extra Physical Attack) magic damage and 8% of current HP magic damage to enemies along the route, and reducing enemy movement speed by 25% for 1.5 seconds. Restores 20 energy when skill 1 hits.

forms.name: Skill 2: Guard mode
forms.description: Surround yourself with spiritual energy, dealing 100 (100 + 70% of Extra Physical Attack) magic damage to nearby enemies, granting yourself a 450 (450 + 170% of Extra Physical Attack) shield for 5 seconds, and increasing attack speed by 30%. While the shield is present, Tiger's Fist deals 20 (20 + 14% of Extra Physical Attack) magic damage to nearby enemies every 0.5 seconds.

forms.name: Skill 2: Tiger leap
forms.description:
Charges in the specified direction and deals 160 (160 + 70% of Extra Physical Attack) physical damage to enemies along the route. If you touch the terrain while charging, you will be stuck for 1 second, and if you charge again in the specified direction using the direction keys, you will deal 320 (320 + 140% of Extra Physical Attack) physical damage to enemies on your route.
When the charge hits an enemy, it recovers 20 energy and reduces the Cooldown of skill 2 by 30%.

skill2.name: Skill 2: Guard mode
skill2.description: Surround yourself with spiritual energy, dealing 100 (100 + 70% of Extra Physical Attack) magic damage to nearby enemies, granting yourself a 450 (450 + 170% of Extra Physical Attack) shield for 5 seconds, and increasing attack speed by 30%. While the shield is present, Tiger's Fist deals 20 (20 + 14% of Extra Physical Attack) magic damage to nearby enemies every 0.5 seconds.

forms.name: Skill 3: Tiger Fushou
forms.description:
Switches to tiger mode, increasing movement speed by 15% for 1 second and boosting next 2 normal attacks for 5 seconds.
1st enhanced Basic Attack: Rushes towards the target, dealing 185 (20 + 100% of physical attack) physical damage and greatly reducing movement speed. After the first enhanced Basic Attack is activated, the enhanced state of the next Basic Attack will last for 5 seconds.
2nd enhanced Basic Attack: Deals 185 (20 + 100% of physical attack) magic damage to enemies within range in front of you.

forms.name: Skill 3: Form fist
forms.description:
Switches to humanoid mode, increases movement speed by 15% for 1 second, and strengthens next Basic Attack for 5 seconds.
Enhanced Basic Attack fires a powerful bursting bullet at the target, dealing 265 (100 + 100% of physical attack) magic damage to the target and enemies in a fan-shaped area behind it.

skill3.name: Skill 3: Tiger Fushou
skill3.description:
Switches to tiger mode, increasing movement speed by 15% for 1 second and boosting next 2 normal attacks for 5 seconds.
1st enhanced Basic Attack: Rushes towards the target, dealing 185 (20 + 100% of physical attack) physical damage and greatly reducing movement speed. After the first enhanced Basic Attack is activated, the enhanced state of the next Basic Attack will last for 5 seconds.
2nd enhanced Basic Attack: Deals 185 (20 + 100% of physical attack) magic damage to enemies within range in front of you.

strengths: Its greatest strength is its ability to maintain long-distance firepower and self-defense with a shield in human mode, and the flexibility of being able to use its high mobility and rush burst damage in tiger mode. He is a versatile hero who has very high engagement ability from the beginning, and can deal effective damage to enemy tanks with the percentage damage of skill 1.
weaknesses: Since it does not have any hard CC (such as stun), it cannot completely stop the enemy's actions and is dependent on the CC of its allies. In addition, a high level of situational judgment ability is required to use both modes perfectly, and in the 5-on-5 teamfights in the final stages, short range and low durability are easily exposed, making the battles extremely difficult.

passive.name: Passive Skill: Fearless
passive.description: When a weapon hits an enemy, it recovers its own energy (7 for normal attacks, 10 for skills. If it hits a non-hero, the amount recovered is halved). When energy is 30 or more, own skills are strengthened, and each time you launch a Basic Attack, you gain 50 energy and recover 30 maximum HP. When an enhanced skill is activated, it automatically consumes 30 energy. After leaving the battle, energy gradually decreases.

skill1.name: Skill 1: Crushing Blade
skill1.description:
Swings your weapon twice, dealing 80 (80 + 100% of physical damage) physical damage to enemies hit each time. Recovers own HP by 30 (30 + 16% of Extra Physical Attack damage) with each hit.
When enhanced: Damage increases to 120 (120 + 150% of Extra Physical Attack damage) and recovery amount increases to 60 (60 + 32% of Extra Physical Attack damage). For every 1% of HP lost, HP recovery effect increases by 1%.

skill2.name: Skill 2: Storm of Assault
skill2.description:
Charges forward and deals 150 (150 + 75% of physical damage) physical damage to enemies along the route. At the end of the charge, the next Basic Attack will be strengthened, dealing an additional 200 (200 + 100% of physical damage) physical damage and reducing movement speed by 50% for 2 seconds.
When enhanced: Increases the damage of enhanced normal attacks to 300 (300 + 150% physical damage), knocks up and stuns the target for 1 second, then reduces movement speed by 50% for 1 second.

skill3.name: Skill 3: Field of Force
skill3.description:
Slams the ground, dealing 250 (250 + 100% physical damage) physical damage to surrounding enemies and reducing movement speed by 50% for 1.5 seconds. At the same time, gain a shield that absorbs 1000 damage (lasts for 6 seconds).
When enhanced: Damage increases to 375 (375 + 150% of physical damage) and shield absorption increases to 1500. Additionally, it absorbs energy from surrounding enemies, recovering 50 HP and increasing movement speed by 20% for 1 second for each enemy hero hit.

strategy.earlyGame: Biron is a lane-dominant Clash Lane fighter focused on managing his energy bar. Basic attacks and abilities build energy. When your energy is at or above one bar (30+), your skills become enhanced and deal massive damage with lifesteal. Constantly hit minions to keep your energy high before engaging the enemy laner.
strategy.midGame: Your mid-game teamfight presence is terrifying. Look for flanks where you can engage multiple enemies. Biron deals insane AoE damage and heals heavily based on the number of targets hit. Use Skill 2 to dash and position yourself, then unleash an enhanced Skill 1 to obliterate the enemy frontline and backline simultaneously.
strategy.lateGame: In the late game, you serve as a frontline diver and disruptor. You can tank immense amounts of damage as long as you are hitting multiple targets with your enhanced Skill 1 and Ultimate. However, you are vulnerable to heavy crowd control and kiting. Ensure you have Flash ready for crucial engages.
strategy.teamfight: Stack energy on jungle camps or minions before the fight if possible. Dash in with Skill 2, knock up the primary target with the enhanced basic attack, immediately drop your Ultimate to slow them and gain a massive shield (while generating energy), and finish with an enhanced Skill 1 for massive AoE burst and healing.
strategy.commonMistakes: Engaging with zero energy, resulting in weak, unenhanced skills and no sustain. Getting kited out and missing the enhanced Skill 1 on the primary targets.

combos.title: Full Energy Annihilation
combos.description: Skill 2 (Dash) -> Enhanced Basic Attack (Knockup) -> Skill 3 -> Enhanced Skill 1. Dash in, knock the target up, slam the ground with Ultimate to steal shields and deal damage, then spin with enhanced Skill 1 to heal and execute.

combos.title: Lane Trading Spin
combos.description: Build 1 Bar Energy -> Skill 1 (Enhanced) -> Skill 2 (Dash out). Walk up and use the enhanced electrical spin to deal heavy damage and heal off the enemy/minions, then dash away to safety.

synergy.reason: Stealth and strong pull make it easier to hit multiple people with Mad Iron skills and area damage.
Because the shield and teleport provided by Ult can safely support Mad Iron's brute force dive.

counters.reason: A strong shield offsets the damage of Mad Iron, giving it an advantageous trade in lane battles.
This is because the guaranteed damage penetrates Mad Iron's reliable shield and causes great damage.

strengths: The strengthening effect of each skill when energy is 30 or more is amazing, and it has all the elements necessary for a fighter at a high level, such as super recovery with skill 1, guaranteed hard CC with skill 2, and huge shield acquisition with skill 3. In particular, Skill 1's ability to recover from low HP is one of the strongest among all heroes.
weaknesses: All strength depends on energy, so in situations where there is no way to store energy before battle (such as being pushed into your own territory), your combat power will be extremely reduced. Also, the range of the skill is very short, and if you are kited by a long-range hero who has plenty of crowd control such as movement speed reduction, you will be unable to do anything.

passive.name: robot
passive.description:
Every time you defeat an enemy, a robot will be automatically summoned to attack the enemy for 6 seconds. Robots that are not defeated by the end of the duration will combine with nearby robots of the same level and level up (maximum Lv.3). If there are no robots nearby that can be combined, the robot will self-destruct, dealing 200 (200 + 30% of Magical Attack) magic damage to nearby enemies (blast radius increases depending on robot level).
Robot Basic Attack: 120 (120 + 25% of Magical Attack) magic damage, HP: 500 (500 + 110% of Magical Attack), Movement speed: 450 (450 + 10% of Magical Attack).
Damage from tower/crystal attacks is reduced by 75%. Each time they combine, Basic Attack and self-destruct damage increases by 30%, and maximum HP increases by 20%.
Up to 4 (Lv.1)/2 (Lv.2)/1 (Lv.3) robots can exist at the same time. When the upper limit is exceeded, the robots summoned first will combine/self-destruct.

skill1.name: fighter bombing
skill1.description:
Launch a fighter jet in the specified direction and perform multiple attacks on the enemy closest to you along the route. Each attack deals 65 (65 + 10% Magical Attack) magic damage, and every second attack deals 140 (140 + 20% Magical Attack) magic damage to the nearest enemy.
If you activate Skill 1 again while the fighter is in flight, it will transform into two small fighter planes, each of which will perform multiple attacks on the nearest enemy on its route. Each attack deals 65 (65 + 10% of Magical Attack) magic damage. When an enemy is attacked by two small fighters at the same time, their movement speed is reduced by 25% for 1.5 seconds.

skill2.name: Forced advance
skill2.description:
Drops two robots at the specified location and deals 100 (100 + 20% of Magical Attack) magic damage to surrounding enemies when they land. The robot will start attacking nearby enemies after 1 second.
Stack Skill 2 once every 15 to 12 seconds (subject to cooldown reduction). Up to 3 stacks.

skill3.name: magnetic field imprint
skill3.description:
Fire a signal device at a target or enemy tower/crystal to create an imprint that lasts 3 seconds and stuns non-tower units for 0.75 seconds. While inscribed, deals 80 (80 + 4% of Magical Attack) magic damage every 0.5 seconds and reduces enemy movement speed by 15%. The engraving will explode when the duration expires, dealing magic damage to the target and surrounding enemies equal to 25% of the damage dealt to the target while the engraving was applied.
If you defeat the target before the engraving disappears, 3 robots will be summoned. When activated, allied robots within range will have their attack speed increased by 100% and their movement speed increased by 100%, and will immediately begin attacking the target.
The stun effect of the signal device has no effect on towers/crystals.

strategy.earlyGame: Milady is a Mid Lane push specialist who relies on her mechanical minions to do the dirty work. Spam your Skill 2 to summon robots and aggressively shove the minion wave into the enemy tower. By keeping the enemy mage constantly clearing under their tower, you create immense map pressure and rotational freedom for your jungler.
strategy.midGame: Your sole objective is to take down towers. Whenever the enemy mid laner roams to a side lane, brutally punish them by using your mechanical army and Ultimate (which can be cast on towers) to instantly melt their Mid tier 1 or tier 2 tower. Avoid river skirmishes without your team.
strategy.lateGame: In the late game, your raw teamfight damage falls off compared to traditional burst mages, but your siege potential is unmatched. Play safely in the backline. Send waves of robots into the enemy base to tank tower shots and slowly chip away at the high ground inhibitors.
strategy.teamfight: Stay far away from enemy assassins. Constantly spawn robots with Skill 2 and throw Skill 1 airplanes to poke and slow. If an assassin jumps on you, drop your Ultimate directly on them to stun and amplify the damage of your robots attacking them, while you run for your life.
strategy.commonMistakes: Wandering into the unwarded river or jungle alone; Milady has absolutely no mobility and will instantly die to any gank. Forgetting that her Ultimate can and should be used on enemy towers for massive siege damage.

combos.title: Tower Demolition
combos.description: Skill 2 (x2) -> Skill 3 (On Tower) -> Skill 1. Summon a horde of robots, cast your Ultimate directly onto the enemy tower to amplify all damage it takes, and throw the airplane to push the lane faster.

combos.title: Anti-Dive Stun
combos.description: Skill 3 -> Skill 2 -> Skill 1 -> Run away. When dived, instantly Ultimate the assassin to stun them and mark them, drop robots at your feet to swarm them, and throw Skill 1 while escaping.

synergy.reason: This is because the movement speed buff compensates for the lack of mobility and allows the tower siege by deploying robots to proceed smoothly.
This is because it prevents enemies from approaching and creates an environment where Milady can safely summon robots and use her ultimate.

counters.reason: They ignore robots and quickly approach them with high mobility, and are instantly defeated by powerful burst damage.
With a wide range of skills, the robot army that he had worked so hard to summon could be easily wiped out.

strengths: Its greatest strength is its ability to summon a large number of robots to fight on its behalf, demonstrating overwhelming pushing power and tower-destroying abilities from a safe distance. You can also make robots take the attacks of towers, so you have the power to break towers without minions. Skill 3's reliable stun on a single target and the raging robot's burst damage are also powerful.
weaknesses: They have no mobility and are extremely vulnerable to assassins who ignore robots and attack from long distances. Additionally, if you are able to escape outside of the robot's attack range, it will be difficult to deal damage, and enemies with ranged magic attacks will instantly take care of the robot army, so depending on the opponent's composition, your strengths may be completely destroyed.

passive.name: Passive Skill: Mountain Demon/White Deer
passive.description: When you receive a hard CC effect such as knockup, knockback, or traction, transform into a deer for 4 seconds (activated once every 60 seconds). While in deer form, you cannot attack or be attacked, and reduce the movement speed of enemies around you by 30%.

skill1.name: Skill 1: Young Spirit
skill1.description:
Fires an energy bullet that deals 250 (250 + 30% of magic damage) magic damage to enemies along the route. If it detects an enemy hero before reaching the end point, it will track the enemy, dealing magic damage, knocking it up for 0.5 seconds, and gaining vision for 5 seconds.
Possessed state: Tracking range increases by 20%.
Deer state: quickly returns to human form.

skill2.name: Skill 2: Wind Blessing
skill2.description:
Automatically attacks up to 3 enemies (prioritizing heroes) for 5 seconds, dealing 200 (200 + 30% of magic damage) magic damage each time. While active, normal attacks cannot be performed.
Possessed: Attack range increases by 20%.
Deer state: Jump forward.

skill3.name: Skill 3: Protection of Independence
skill3.description:
Possesses another allied hero and grants a shield that absorbs all damage for 750 (750 + 50% of magic damage + 10% of maximum HP). When possessed, the Cooldown of all skills is reduced by 30%. When the shield is destroyed, the possession status is removed and the spell goes on cooldown. If you remove possession from yourself, 50% of the cooldown will be returned.
Deer status: Gives nearby allies a movement speed increase effect.

strategy.earlyGame: Yaria is a highly dependent Support enchanter who possesses an ally. Start by helping your mid laner clear the first wave using your Skill 2 auto-targeting magic. Then, rotate with your jungler to secure the early crabs and gank. Use Skill 1 to scout bushes; the energy blast will auto-track hidden enemies and knock them up.
strategy.midGame: Once you hit Level 4, your Ultimate allows you to attach to a teammate, granting them a massive true-damage shield. Identify the most fed player on your team (usually the Jungler or Marksman) and become their personal guardian. While attached, your Skill 1 and Skill 2 ranges are increased.
strategy.lateGame: In late-game teamfights, your true-shield is the difference between your carry dying instantly or wiping the enemy team. Do not stay attached until the shield breaks completely. If you manually detach before the shield is destroyed, your Ultimate cooldown is drastically reduced.
strategy.teamfight: Attach to your primary carry. Spam Skill 2 to deal continuous magical damage and Skill 1 to interrupt enemy channels or reveal assassins. When your shield is about to break, jump off manually, absorb a soft crowd control spell to trigger your Deer passive (invulnerability), and then jump back onto the carry once your cooldown resets.
strategy.commonMistakes: Allowing the Ultimate shield to be completely broken by enemy damage, resulting in a painfully long cooldown. Staying in human form too long during teamfights where you are incredibly squishy.

combos.title: The Infinite Shield Loop
combos.description: Skill 3 (Attach) -> Skill 1 -> Skill 2 -> Skill 3 (Manual Detach right before shield breaks) -> Wait briefly -> Skill 3 (Re-attach). Maximizes uptime on your carry by refunding cooldown through manual detachment.

combos.title: Bush Scout & Disable
combos.description: Skill 1 (Into Brush) -> Wait for auto-track knockup -> Skill 3 (Attach to engaging ally). Safely check for ambushes and immediately provide a shield to the ally diving the revealed target.

synergy.reason: It has high mobility, and Ao's shield and CC perfectly support diving with ult.
He is a highly mobile assassin, and when possessed by Yao, he is able to perform powerful ganks that ignore terrain.

counters.reason: Due to the shield-effective passive and long range, Yao's strong point, the shield, can be easily stripped away.
Due to the overwhelming burst damage, the possessed ally will be blown away along with the shield.

strengths: His greatest strength is his ability to fight while reliably protecting his allies through possession and shielding provided by Skill 3. In addition, even if they receive hard CC, they become invincible by turning into deer form and can make the enemy's CC skills useless, so they have extremely high survivability and are good at continuous visibility and obstruction.
weaknesses: Its own firepower and durability are extremely low, and it cannot demonstrate its strengths in situations where there are no allies. Also, since the passive deer transformation only activates once every 60 seconds, there is a high risk of being defeated if you receive hard CC during the cooldown, so you must always be careful where you stand.

passive.name: Passive Skill: Cloud God's Wings
passive.description: Enters battle in flight, increases movement speed by 50, and can move ignoring terrain. Normal attacks become melee attacks that deal physical damage equal to 4% of maximum HP (+1% Extra Physical Attack damage). Damaging an enemy while flying increases movement speed by 15 and defense penetration by 5% (up to 3 stacks). When passing through terrain, the flight state persists.

skill1.name: Skill 1: Celestial Rumbling
skill1.description: Gradually increases your movement speed for 2 seconds (up to 150%). If you hold it down, the movement speed increase effect will continue. When you release your finger, you will charge in the specified direction, dealing 200 (200 + 60% of Extra Physical Attack damage) physical damage to the enemy and stunning them for 0.5 seconds. After charging, move behind the target and remove your own movement speed increase effect.

skill2.name: Skill 2: Wakaei Hana no Mai
skill2.description: Fires feather blades around you, dealing 200 (200 + 50% of Extra Physical Attack damage) physical damage to the enemy. Enemies hit have their movement speed reduced by 30% for 1 second. While active, damage taken by yourself is reduced by 30%.

skill3.name: Skill 3: Guidance of Wind and Thunder
skill3.description: Jump into the air and become untargetable for 0.5 seconds. Then, it swoops down and attacks the enemy, dealing 350 (350 + 100% of Extra Physical Attack damage) physical damage and knocking it up for 0.5 seconds. After plummeting, it rains feather blades, dealing 100 (100 + 20% of Extra Physical Attack damage) physical damage to enemies within the area per second and reducing movement speed by 30% for 1 second.

strategy.earlyGame: Yunzhongjun is a unique Jungle assassin who can fly over all terrain. Exploit this passive to take completely unpredictable jungle pathing. Invade the enemy jungle relentlessly from Level 1, as your bleed passive makes your early 1v1 dueling almost unbeatable. Maintain your energy (breath) by hitting targets so you don't fall out of the sky.
strategy.midGame: You dictate the pace of the game. Ignore walls and flank from angles the enemy cannot ward. Use Skill 1 to dive-bomb priority targets. Upon hitting them, your basic attacks will shred their armor and stack a lethal bleed. If they try to flash away, the bleed will often finish them off.
strategy.lateGame: Teamfighting is difficult because you are extremely fragile. You operate strictly as a kamikaze diver or cleanup crew. Wait for the enemy tank to burn their CC, fly over the walls directly onto the enemy marksman, burst them, and use your Ultimate (which makes you untargetable) to either finish them or stall for your team to arrive.
strategy.teamfight: Never enter from the front. Hover over a wall out of vision. Dive bomb with Skill 1 onto the carry. Spam basic attacks to stack the bleed. The moment the enemy team turns to focus you, cast your Ultimate to become untargetable and drop a barrage of feathers on them.
strategy.commonMistakes: Running out of breath and walking on the ground (losing your terrain-ignoring passive) before a fight starts. Engaging first and getting CC'd before you can cast your untargetable Ultimate.

combos.title: Death from Above
combos.description: Skill 1 (Hold & Release) -> Basic Attacks (x4) -> Skill 2 -> Skill 3. Dive-bomb the target for a stun, rapidly apply 4 bleed stacks with basic attacks, use Skill 2 to parry their retaliation, and Ultimate to dodge their peel and secure the kill.

combos.title: Untargetable Escape
combos.description: Skill 1 -> Basic Attack -> Skill 3 (Over Wall). Dive a target near a wall, deal a quick burst of damage, and immediately use Ultimate's untargetability and movement to glide back over the wall to safety.

synergy.reason: This is because it can restrain the enemy with strong CC and ensure Kumo no Kun's dive into the back line.
To increase Kumochu's survivability and kill line with shields and additional CC to help him escape safely.

counters.reason: This is because you can forcibly shoot down Kumochu-kun, who flies in while in flight, using target-specified suppression CC.
This is because you can restrain Kumochu-kun who dives without missing with a certain suppression CC and lead to a kill.

strengths: The ability to move while completely ignoring the terrain allows for surprise attacks and escapes from unpredictable routes. strategy.earlyGame: Li Xin is a Clash Lane fighter who starts weak but unlocks two distinct forms at Level 4. Play extremely safe before Level 4, using Skill 2 to last hit minions and poke the enemy from a distance. Do not fight. Once you hit Level 4, choose Light Form for massive AoE teamfight damage, or Dark Form for split-pushing and dueling.
strategy.midGame: (Light Form): Sit behind your frontline, charge your Skill 3 (Ultimate) to unleash three massive waves of sword aura. You are essentially a physical mage. (Dark Form): Ignore teamfights. Use your insane movement speed and CC immunity (Skill 1) to ruthlessly split-push and steal the enemy jungle. Duel anyone who tries to stop you.
strategy.lateGame: (Light Form): Defend high ground or siege perfectly. Your charged Ultimate can single-handedly clear super minions or wipe out half the enemy team's HP. (Dark Form): Create immense macro pressure. While the enemy team contests a Dragon, you can take an inhibitor tower in seconds. Force them to split their attention.
strategy.teamfight: (Light Form): Stay safely in the back. Use Skill 1 to reposition. Charge Ultimate in a brush for an ambush, or use it when the enemy groups up. Spam Skill 2 waves. (Dark Form): Do not front-to-back teamfight. Flank to assassinate the enemy marksman with your rapid basic attacks, or just keep split-pushing to pull enemies away from the objective.
strategy.commonMistakes: Trying to play Dark Form like a frontline teamfighter, resulting in instant death. Using Light Form's Ultimate without charging it, severely reducing its damage and range. Feeding before reaching Level 4.

strategy.earlyGame: Garo is a late-game hyper-carry Farm Lane marksman with the longest attack range in the game when her Skill 1 is active. In the early game, turn on Skill 1 to poke enemy laners safely from afar, but watch your mana bar closely as it drains rapidly. Focus purely on farming and surviving ganks.
strategy.midGame: As you acquire core critical strike items, your passive truly shines. Every critical strike you land heavily slows the target. Use Skill 1 to siege towers from outside their retaliation range. Stay glued to your support or tank, as you have absolutely no mobility or dash abilities to escape assassins.
strategy.lateGame: You are an untouchable turret of death. With full items, a single critical hit from max range will slow an enemy so severely they can never reach you. Your Skill 2 silence is a fantastic tool to interrupt enemy initiators. If played with perfect positioning, you will melt the entire enemy team before they can touch you.
strategy.teamfight: Activate your Ultimate to boost the critical strike rate of yourself and nearby allies. Turn on Skill 1 and auto-attack the closest threat from maximum range. If an enemy diver approaches, throw Skill 2 to silence them, manually close your Ultimate to gain a burst of movement speed, and kite backward.
strategy.commonMistakes: Leaving Skill 1 active constantly and completely draining your mana, leaving you helpless in a fight. Walking forward to chase a kill and stepping out from behind your frontline.

strategy.earlyGame: Sun Ce is a high-impact Clash Lane or Jungle fighter with exceptional crowd control and global presence. In lane, aggressively trade using your Skill 1 and Skill 2. Your passive grants you armor stacks whenever you take physical damage, making you incredibly tanky against AD matchups. Clear waves fast and look for Level 4.
strategy.midGame: Your Ultimate is a game-changer. You summon a ship and sail across the map, completely ignoring crowd control while driving. Use this to constantly gank the Mid or Farm lanes. A direct crash into an enemy knocks them up, allowing you to instantly burst squishy targets. Coordinate with your jungler for unmatched map pressure.
strategy.lateGame: You are the primary initiator. A flawless ship crash into the enemy backline can win the game instantly. However, the ship's steering becomes harder the longer you sail. Plan your routes carefully and avoid crashing into terrain. If you miss the primary target, quickly jump off the ship manually to join the fight.
strategy.teamfight: Start from the jungle or a side lane out of vision. Sail your Ultimate directly into the enemy team's squishiest members. Upon crashing (or jumping off early to let the ship crash), immediately follow up with Skill 1 for a second knock-up. Then spam your Skill 2 cleaves while weaving in basic attacks to annihilate the target.
strategy.commonMistakes: Crashing the ship into a wall before reaching the teamfight. Engaging with the ship when your teammates are too far away to follow up on the massive crowd control you provide.

Also, it is highly dependent on skills, and if you remove skills 1 and 3, you will lose mobility and CC, and you will be easily kited by the enemy. weaknesses: Skill 3 is extremely difficult to operate, and unless you successfully charge, you will not be able to demonstrate proper firepower or survivability. Also, since you are completely defenseless after jumping, if you are unable to defeat the enemy, or if you receive a hard CC while charging before becoming invincible, you will be defeated without being able to do anything.

weaknesses: Burst damage (instantaneous firepower) is low and relies on the continuous damage of Soul Chain, so if the enemy can escape quickly, you will not be able to deal enough damage. Also, in order to take advantage of recovery and slashing effects, it is necessary to stay close to the enemy camp, and if you are blocked by a strong CC chain, you will be defeated without being able to do anything.

strategy.earlyGame: Bai Long requires careful farming early on to reach his power spikes. Prioritize full clearing your jungle and look for opportunistic ganks only when success is highly probable. strategy.lateGame: In the late game, Bai Long is a deadly backline threat. Play patiently on the fringes of the teamfight, waiting for the perfect moment when enemy crowd control and defensive cooldowns are blown. A successful flank can instantly eliminate the enemy marksman or mage.

strategy.lateGame: In late-game fights, Yao is a disruptor and an assassin. Wait for the initial engagement, then dive the backline using your enhanced skills. Your ultimate is your key to surviving burst and resetting your cooldowns, making you a slippery and persistent threat.

strengths: His greatest strengths are the overwhelming number of moves he can use repeatedly, and the combo of strengthened skills and attacks using star power.
