counters.reason: By removing the entire debuff and disabling CC, Xi Shi's traction skill can be completely disabled.
Because of his high charging power and silence skill, he was able to get close and be instantly killed before Xishi could pull him away.

strategy.earlyGame: Xi Shi should focus on fast wave clear and heavy roaming. Use your long-range poke to whittle down the enemy mid laner. Once you hit level 4, coordinate with your jungler for guaranteed ganks using your unique pulling mechanic to displace enemies out of safety.
strategy.midGame: Control the flow of skirmishes by manipulating enemy positioning. Before contesting objectives, try to catch a priority target with your first skill. A successful pull can lead to a quick kill, turning the upcoming objective fight into a 5v4 advantage.
strategy.lateGame: Your pulling mechanic scales incredibly well as getting caught late game means instant death. Position yourself safely behind your frontline and constantly fish for pulls on the enemy carries. Use your ultimate to reduce cooldowns and provide continuous crowd control.
strategy.teamfight: Focus on disrupting the enemy formation. Pull their frontliners away from your carries, or pull their damage dealers into your team's burst range. Your ultimate allows you to cast your pull multiple times; use this to create absolute chaos and dictate the fight's pace.
strategy.commonMistakes: Missing the initial skillshot of the pull, overextending to secure a pull and getting caught, and forgetting to activate the ultimate for the empowered pull.

combos.title: Irresistible Force
combos.description: Skill 1 -> Skill 3 -> Skill 1 (Pull) -> Skill 2 -> Skill 1 (Pull). Land the initial tether, activate ultimate to reset and empower, pull the enemy into your Skill 2 damage pool, and pull them again to keep them trapped.

combos.title: Quick Displacement
combos.description: Skill 2 -> Skill 1 -> Skill 1 (Pull). Throw out your damage pool, instantly cast the tether to catch them, and pull them directly into the center of the damage.

strengths: Skill 1's unique and powerful hard CC that "forcibly moves the enemy's position in a specified direction" is its greatest strength. This allows you to drag enemy carries in front of your allies or push them under towers. Skill 3's Cooldown reset and double movement effect will dramatically increase its interfering ability.
weaknesses: His self-defense method relies on skill 1, CC, and he has no movement skills at all, so he is extremely weak when approached by assassins. Also, it is difficult to maintain a sense of distance to make use of the passive, and if you miss the throw of skill 1, your presence will be greatly reduced, making it difficult to generate firepower or protect yourself.

passive.name: scorching armillary
passive.description:
For every 5% increase in attack speed, cooldown is reduced by 1%. When normal attacks and skills hit the target, your Fury value increases by 5 (increases by 10 for critical hits). When the rage value reaches the upper limit, the character becomes excited.
Excited state: Enhances all own skills and reduces the cooldown of "Frenzy of Flames" and "Explosive Cannon" by 25% to 50%. Recovers (0 to 3 + 1% of physical attack) HP each time the rage value exceeds the upper limit by 1.
If you do not obtain Fury value for a certain period of time, your Fury value will continuously decrease after 3 seconds.

skill1.name: flames of frenzy
skill1.description:
``Architen'' sweeps for 5 seconds, dealing 96 (40 + 34% of physical attack) physical damage per shot. Movement speed is reduced by 50 while strafing, and goes on cooldown when strafing ends.
Excited state: Bullets will now penetrate, dealing 50% damage to enemies after penetration. For every 2% increase in attack speed, bullet fire rate increases by 1% (up to a maximum of 100%).
Long press allows you to strafe, and damage can be dealt by critical hits. You can stop strafing for a certain period of time and activate other skills. Each enemy hit increases the Fury value by 5, and a critical hit increases the Fury value by 10.
Skill activation speed increases by 1% for every 2% attack speed increase.

skill2.name: explosive gun
skill2.description:
Attacks in the specified direction with a heavy cannon, dealing 200 (200 + 50% of Extra Physical Attack) physical damage to the enemy hit and reducing movement speed by 25% for 2 seconds. When it hits an enemy or wall, or reaches maximum distance, it explodes and splits into 5 bullets. The shot bounces off walls and deals 410 (410 + 100% of Extra Physical Attack) physical damage to the first enemy it hits.
Excited: Number of shotguns increases from 5 to 9.
Each time your heavy artillery and shotguns hit an enemy, your Fury value increases by 5. If multiple shotguns hit the same target within 1 second, the damage is reduced to 25%.

skill3.name: missile support
skill3.description:
Searches the surrounding environment, and when a friendly hero attacks an enemy within range, it will mark the target's location (up to 5). After completing the search, fire a missile and deal 450 (450 + 120% of Extra Physical Attack) physical damage to the enemy it hits. If you hit the same target, the damage will be reduced by 75% and your Fury value will increase by 10. After completing the search, fire up to 1 missile every second for an additional 8 seconds (cooldown reduced by 50% if canceled or interrupted).
Excited: The minimum time between subsequent missile launches is reduced from 1 second to 0.5 seconds.
If you press and hold to activate it, you can expand the search area for up to 3 seconds. Meng's movement speed increases by 50% while searching.

strategy.earlyGame: Meng Ya relies heavily on maintaining a high anger level to enhance his skills. Focus on clearing waves and poking the enemy with your sustained fire. He possesses high early-game pressure; use it to bully the enemy marksman and take down the outer tower quickly.
strategy.midGame: Your teamfight presence is massive. Stick with your support and rotate to objectives. Use your ultimate to rain down missiles from afar, providing covering fire for your team's engages. Always try to enter fights with a full anger bar for the healing and enhanced damage.
strategy.lateGame: Positioning is critical as you lack a true dash. Stand behind your tanks and unleash a relentless barrage of bullets. The sheer volume of AoE damage you deal can single-handedly melt the enemy team if left unchecked. Beware of flanking assassins.
strategy.teamfight: Activate your ultimate early to start bombarding the area. Use your first skill continuously while moving to kite approaching enemies. The healing from your enraged state is your primary survival tool, so keep dealing damage to stay alive while retreating.
strategy.commonMistakes: Entering a fight with zero anger, stopping to basic attack instead of using the mobile Skill 1, and poor positioning against dive compositions.

combos.title: Suppressive Fire
combos.description: Skill 3 -> Skill 2 -> Skill 1. Activate ultimate for area bombardment, shoot Skill 2 against a wall to scatter the damage and slow, then channel Skill 1 while strafing to shred targets.

combos.title: Corner Pressure
combos.description: Skill 2 -> Skill 1. Use the bouncing mechanic of Skill 2 in tight jungle corridors to deal massive burst, followed by the sustained damage of Skill 1 to finish them.

synergy.reason: Since it protects you on the front lines, it is easy to safely deliver sustained firepower from long distances.
With its strong support ability and recovery, it creates an environment where it can continue to provide firepower in teamfights.

counters.reason: This is because their high mobility allows them to close the distance, and when their escape performance is low, they can be defeated by a burst of high firepower.
It has high pressure and mobility from the beginning, and can easily be approached and deal damage.

strengths: Its strengths are its ability to significantly strengthen its skills through excitement, and its ability to continue fighting by recovering HP when the upper limit is exceeded. Increasing attack speed is directly connected to shortening skill cooldowns and increasing firing speed, allowing you to utilize the Basic Attack status without wasting it even though it depends on skills. Also, with skill 3, which provides missile support over a wide area, he is also excellent in that he can provide powerful support to his allies in battle even if he is far away.
weaknesses: The weak point is that the skill performance is low when the rage value is not accumulated, and it is highly dependent on the excited state. While using skill 1, which reduces movement speed, it is difficult to avoid enemy skills, and because you do not have movement skills to supplement your mobility, it is difficult to escape if you are brought into close combat. Also, skill 3's missiles depend on allies' attacks, so they cannot demonstrate their true value in situations where you cannot coordinate with allies.

passive.name: hunting
passive.description: When an enemy's HP falls below 30%, the enemy will be given the "prey" stamp. Normal attacks and skills against enemies with the engraving deal an additional 7.5% to 15% true damage.

skill1.name: crushing
skill1.description:
Magical power puts you in diving mode for 3 seconds and increases your movement speed by 40. When finished, it returns to normal mode and shortens the Cooldown by 50%.
If you activate "Tosai" while in diving mode, it will jump out of the water and attack. Charges in the specified direction, dealing 300 (300 + 120% of Extra Physical Attack) physical damage to enemies along the route and reducing enemy movement speed by 25% for 1.5 seconds.

skill2.name: Danku
skill2.description:
Slash the enemy twice, dealing 225 (225 + 45% of Extra Physical Attack) physical damage each time. You can obtain 1 stack of engravings each time you activate a skill, and you can obtain an additional engraving each time you hit an enemy (you cannot obtain more than one stack from the same enemy. Up to 3 stacks). Hitting an enemy will restore 85 HP (85 + 15% of Extra Physical Attack + 1% of additional maximum HP) (halved for non-hero units).
If the engravings are stacked, one stack of engravings will be consumed during a Basic Attack to strengthen the next Basic Attack. Enhanced Basic Attack charges at the enemy, dealing 177 (50 + 75% of physical attack) physical damage and recovering own HP by 85 (85 + 15% of Extra Physical Attack + 1% of additional maximum HP). The cooldown of Skill 2 is reduced by 10% to 20% for each follow-up attack.
If you activate Skill 2 while in diving mode, you will rush in the specified direction and the Cooldown of Skill 1 will be reduced by 25%.

skill3.name: execution
skill3.description:
Throws a dagger in the specified direction, greatly reducing the movement speed of enemies along the route for 0.5 seconds. After a certain period of time, it will rush towards the dagger's location, deal 520 (520 + 180% of Extra Physical Attack) physical damage to enemies along the route, and pull them to the dagger's destination.
When in diving mode, pulls enemies along the route to the end of the rush and reduces skill 1's Cooldown by 50%.

strategy.earlyGame: Lan excels at fast clears and early skirmishes around the river. Use his dive form to navigate quickly between camps and lanes. Look for overextended low-health targets, as his passive grants true damage against injured enemies, making his early ganks exceptionally lethal.
strategy.midGame: Dominate the map by controlling the river and utilizing your insane mobility. Lan thrives in chaotic teamfights where he can dash continuously between multiple targets. Secure objectives by assassinating the enemy jungler before the smite fight occurs.
strategy.lateGame: In the late game, patience is key. Wait for the enemy team to exhaust their crowd control. Use your ultimate to drag key carries out of position and into your team. Your ability to self-heal and reset cooldowns makes you a nightmare if not locked down instantly.
strategy.teamfight: Avoid initiating unless you have a perfect ultimate angle to isolate a squishy target. Use your second skill to dance around the frontline, stacking marks and healing. Once the enemy backline is exposed or drops below the true damage threshold, dive in and execute them.
strategy.commonMistakes: Diving 1v5 without team follow-up, missing the ultimate which leaves you out of position, and failing to utilize the basic attack resets after casting Skill 2.

combos.title: Deep Sea Execute
combos.description: Skill 1 -> Skill 3 -> Skill 2 -> Basic Attacks. Submerge with Skill 1 to close the gap, leap out with Skill 3 to drag the target back, hit Skill 2 to gain marks, and spam basic attacks to dash and execute.

combos.title: Shark Dance
combos.description: Skill 2 -> Basic Attack (x2) -> Skill 1 (Submerge & Emerge). In close combat, use Skill 2 to mark targets, consume the marks with rapid dashes, then use Skill 1 to dodge abilities or secure the kill.

synergy.reason: It restrains the enemy with powerful CC and creates an opening for a high-firepower burst combo to hit the target.
At the front, you can break up the enemy's formation, attract their attention, and create a chance to safely dive into the enemy's rear line.

counters.reason: This is because the silence skill blocks the continuous firing of skills that support mobility, making it impossible to move.
Frequent stuns from long distances will prevent you from approaching, making it difficult to utilize your unique mobility.

strengths: Its greatest strength is its extremely high mobility due to skill 1, diving, and its damage output and self-healing ability due to skill 2 and the loop of enhanced normal attacks. In addition, his passive effect allows him to inflict guaranteed damage on enemies with HP below 30%, making him extremely effective as an assassin who can reliably take down any remaining enemies. Forced movement using skill 3 from diving mode also greatly contributes to breaking formations in teamfights.
weaknesses: Since your own durability is dependent on recovery, you have the weakness that if you receive strong CC from an enemy (stun, restraint, etc.) and are able to stop the loop of skills and normal attacks, you will be defeated without being able to do anything. Also, the amount healed is halved against non-hero units, which reduces tenacity in areas where there are only minions and monsters. Her weakness is that her passive does not activate against enemies with abundant HP, making it difficult to defeat them alone.

passive.name: mirror image
passive.description:
When the main body and mirror image damage an enemy, they each give two types of marks. When an enemy acquires both marks, the marks are consumed, dealing slashing damage equal to 8% of the target's missing HP, and resetting the cooldowns of Skill 1 and Skill 2. The reset effect can only be activated once every 5 seconds on the same target.
When you use the skill, a mirror image will appear for 2 seconds. The mirror image imitates the actions of the main body, dealing 30% of the damage and gaining 30% of the recovery effect.

skill1.name: Opening the door
skill1.description:
Charges forward and deals 90 (90 + 60% of physical attack) physical damage to enemies in front of you and reduces movement speed by 30% (for 1 second).
At the same time, the next Basic Attack is strengthened and deals an additional 90 (90 + 60% of physical attack) physical damage.

skill2.name: splitting sky
skill2.description:
Deals 90 (90 + 70% of physical attack) physical damage to surrounding enemies and reduces movement speed by 50% (duration: 1 second). Recovers 60 (60 + 24% of physical attack) HP with each hit and applies an effect that reduces movement speed.
If multiple targets are hit, the amount healed is reduced by up to 25% for each subsequent target.

skill3.name: Migata
skill3.description: Acquires 1 stack of ``Migata'' at regular intervals (up to 2 stacks), and when used, activates ``Kyoka Suigetsu'' and replaces its position with its mirror image.

skill4.name: Kyoka Suigetsu
skill4.description:
Charges forward, stuns enemies along the route for 0.5 seconds, and creates a mirror space when it reaches the end. When the space is expanded, enemies in the rush path are drawn to the center of the space. Deployment duration is 10 seconds.
After deploying in space, when a skill is activated or the main body and mirror image perform a Basic Attack, mirror shards will fly towards the enemy, dealing slashing damage equal to 2% of the target's lost HP. Enemies that touch the edge of the space will take 30 (30 + 30% of physical attack) physical damage and have their movement speed reduced by 50%. While in space, damage taken is reduced by 10% and HP is recovered by 10 (10 + 40% of physical attack) every second.

strategy.earlyGame: Jing requires precise mechanics to maximize her clear speed and gank potential. Focus on reaching level 4 quickly, as her ultimate defines her playstyle. Use the mirror image mechanic to tank jungle camps and scout bushes to maintain healthy clears and avoid invades.
strategy.midGame: Jing is a dominant force in mid-game skirmishes. Look for picks in the enemy jungle and side lanes. The shattered glass passive provides massive burst damage. Once you trap an enemy in your ultimate's mirror array, utilize the fast position swapping to confuse and execute them.
strategy.lateGame: Your ability to instantly burst a carry and escape is unparalleled. However, diving blindly into a late-game 5v5 will get you killed. Wait on the flanks, target the enemy marksman, deploy your ultimate to isolate them, execute your combo flawlessly, and swap out.
strategy.teamfight: Patience and positioning are everything. Let the tanks engage. Once the enemy's crucial defensive skills are on cooldown, dash into the backline, activate your ultimate array, and use the rapid cooldown resets between you and your mirror to unleash a flurry of unavoidable damage.
strategy.commonMistakes: Mismanaging the cooldown reset mechanic of the mirror image, deploying the ultimate in a bad spot leaving you trapped, and panicking during the mirror swap sequence.

combos.title: Shattered Array Infinite Swap
combos.description: Skill 1 -> Basic Attack -> Skill 2 -> Skill 3 -> Basic Attack -> Swap -> Skill 1 -> Swap. Dash in, deal damage to apply the mark, pop ultimate to create the arena, and continuously swap places with your clone while weaving attacks to reset cooldowns.

combos.title: Mirror Execution
combos.description: Skill 1 -> Skill 1 (Reset) -> Skill 2. A quick non-ultimate burst. Dash through the enemy with Skill 1, let the clone hit to shatter the mark and reset cooldown, then dash again and use Skill 2 to finish.

synergy.reason: This is because it stops the enemy's movement with a wide range of CC and creates a perfect starting point for skill combos.
Both have high mobility and burst damage, allowing them to quickly annihilate the enemy's back line.

counters.reason: This is because they have extremely high durability and CC, and their skill combos and movements are blocked and they cannot get kills.
Due to the targeted stun and overwhelming burst damage, there is a high risk of being defeated before you can get close.

strengths: Its biggest strengths are its overwhelming instantaneous firepower due to its main body and mirror image, and the ability to reset skill cooldowns by consuming marks. Since the slash damage corresponds to the amount of HP lost, it is extremely capable of delivering the final blow. In addition, skill 2 provides continued power through HP recovery, and skill 3's ability to swap the main body and mirror image allows for a powerful, flexible play style that allows you to safely escape while dealing damage while toying with the enemy.
weaknesses: Because it relies on resetting skill cooldowns, if you are unable to consume marks due to operational errors or enemy evasion, you will suddenly fall into a defenseless state. Also, when using Skill 2, your own movement speed will decrease, so if you make a mistake in your stance, you will be exposing yourself to an opening. It has low durability, and if someone predicts that it will replace skill 3 and is hit with CC (movement blocking), it will reveal its fragility and be defeated in no time.

passive.name: A strange connection with the mountain
passive.description:
Due to a mysterious relationship with monsters, when you get close to a monster, recovery becomes a release (obtains a buff).
When a Basic Attack hits an enemy, it drops a seed bomb and attracts nearby seed bombs. Picking up a seed bomb yourself increases attack speed and movement speed by 3% for 2.5 seconds (up to 6 stacks).
When an enemy touches the seed bomb, it deals 30 (30 + 10% of Extra Physical Attack) physical damage.

skill1.name: rapid growth
skill1.description:
Create a paradise for animals by growing plants. The attack speed and movement speed of Mountain Child and allied monsters will be increased by 15%, HP will be recovered by 40 (40 + 0.6% of additional maximum HP), and allied monsters will come to the paradise and fight together. The status of companion monsters increases with hero level, and the probability of summoning multiple monsters increases with skill level.
50% of the mountain child's status is reflected in the attack power, attack speed, and critical rate of allied monsters.

skill2.name: Roll! Ponpon!
skill2.description:
"Roll! Pon-Pon!": Move forward while rolling with the Pon-Pon (disable hard CC once). While spinning, gain 40 damage block, deal 240 (240 + 80% of Extra Physical Attack) physical damage to hit enemies, and stun them for 1/2 second. If you hit a wall during the effect period, you will bounce (up to 3 times) and the rotation distance will be reset, the skill effect will increase by 25%, and your next Basic Attack will be strengthened. Enhanced Basic Attack releases 3 seed bombs in succession, dealing an additional 60 (60 + 20% of Extra Physical Attack) physical damage.
"Roll! Agudo!": The mountain child rolls forward and strengthens his next Basic Attack. Enhanced Basic Attack releases 3 seed bombs in succession, dealing an additional 60 (60 + 20% of Extra Physical Attack) physical damage.

skill3.name: gorge gathering
skill3.description:
Mounted: Pom Pom moves away from the mountain child and jumps to the specified location, dealing 460 (460 + 150% of Extra Physical Attack) physical damage and stunning her for 2/3 seconds. After that, Pom Pom will act alone (50% of Mountain Child's status and 100% of Basic Attack effect will be reflected).
Separated state: Pom Pom enters recovery mode when defeated. Returns to battle when HP reaches maximum. While Pom Pom is alive, it can be recalled by reactivating it.

strategy.earlyGame: [Jungle] Utilize passive Release (Smite) to clear jungle camps instantly without taking damage. Secure Red & Blue buffs rapidly, hit Level 4, build passive stacks for summoned beasts, and launch early ganks.
strategy.midGame: Deploy Skill 1 Seed Field to grant movement speed and continuous healing for your team in teamfights. Use Skill 2 roll with CC immunity to absorb crowd control and rush objectives with your summoned beasts.
strategy.lateGame: In late teamfights, throw Qiuqiu (Ultimate) directly into the enemy backline to knock up squishy carries. Agudo transitions to ranged basic attacks; re-activate Ultimate to recall Qiuqiu for a massive shield when threatened.
strategy.teamfight: Place Skill 1 healing field under allies, launch Qiuqiu into enemy carries with Ultimate for heavy knockup control, and provide continuous ranged firepower while relying on summoned animals to disrupt the enemy.
strategy.commonMistakes: Taking damage while casting passive Release will interrupt the channel, so watch out for enemy invaders. Remember that Agudo is fragile after throwing Qiuqiu—stay positioned safely and recall Qiuqiu immediately if focused.

combos.title: Fast Jungle Clear: Smite (Release) -> Skill 2 (Roll)
combos.description: Approach jungle camp, use Smite to channel Release for instant clear, then charge Skill 2 to roll rapidly to the next camp.

combos.title: Ultimate Engage: Skill 1 -> Skill 3 (Throw Qiuqiu) -> Ranged Basic Attacks -> Skill 3 (Recall)
combos.description: Deploy Skill 1 field under allies for speed and heal, throw Qiuqiu with Ultimate to knock up enemy backline, attack from range, and re-activate Ultimate to combine when low on HP.

synergy.reason: Continuous recovery greatly increases the ability to continue fighting both when mounted and not mounted.
It provides a strong front line and shield, allowing the main body to continue delivering firepower from a safe distance.

counters.reason: Due to its extremely high mobility, it is easy to destroy the jungle and hinder your farm in the early stages.
This is because they are targeted when they are defenseless when they dismount, and it is difficult to escape due to their high pursuit ability.

strengths: A unique system that lets monsters escape without killing them allows you to travel around the jungle in a safe and special way. Skill 1 provides powerful range buffs and recovery to allies, and by summoning many monsters to fight together, he has extremely good pushing power and control power in teamfights. Pom Pom's ranged stun from a long distance with skill 3 is a powerful initiation method, and it also has the mobility and sabotage ability due to skill 2's CC immunity and bounce.
weaknesses: After separating Pom Pom with skill 3, the mountain child (main body) has low stats and has a weak point that makes it vulnerable to being targeted by assassins. If Pom Pom is defeated, it will take some time for it to return to battle, and during that time its strength will be significantly reduced. Also, if you haven't collected enough jungle monsters, the benefit of skill 1 will be weak, and if you control the pace of the match and invade the enemy's jungle, it will be difficult to recover.

passive.name: Guardian of Fireflies
passive.description:
When you deal damage with a Basic Attack, a firefly will be summoned, dealing 100 (100 + 20% of Magical Attack + 3% of additional maximum HP) magic damage to the enemy and inflicting stealth immunity for 3 seconds. At regular intervals, recovers 60 HP (60 + 10% of Magical Attack + 1.5% of additional maximum HP) of the nearby ally hero with the lowest HP.
If there are no enemies nearby, charging a Basic Attack will restore 60 HP (60 + 10% of Magical Attack + 1.5% of additional maximum HP), but HP recovery of allies will be interrupted.

skill1.name: The power of kuwagi
skill1.description:
Channels the "power of fireflies" into the specified area, dealing 500 (500 + 10% of Magical Attack) magic damage to enemies within the area and knocking them up for 1 second. Hitting an enemy consumes Firefly's power and deals 100 (100 + 20% of Magical Attack + 3% of additional maximum HP) magic damage for each stack of Firefly's power.
If there are friendly heroes nearby, consume Firefly's Power and heal the lowest HP of the friendly hero by 60 (60 + 10% of Magical Attack + 1.5% of additional maximum HP) for each stack of Firefly's Power.
"Power of Firefly": You can obtain 1 stack of Firefly's power every 1.5 seconds (up to 9 stacks). The skill range expands according to the number of stacks.

skill2.name: Wind riding
skill2.description:
Fly to the selected bush, obtain 1 stack of "Firefly Power", and summon 1 firefly every time you fly a certain distance. After 1 second, the fireflies fly towards the hero with the lowest HP, dealing 100 (100 + 20% of Magical Attack + 3% of additional maximum HP) magic damage to the enemy and inflicting stealth immunity for 3 seconds, or healing allied heroes by 60 (60 + 10% of Magical Attack + 1.5% of additional maximum HP) HP.
This skill can be charged 3 times, and when tapped, it flies towards the selected bush.

skill3.name: faint fireflies
skill3.description:
Summons a "bush of light" to the specified location. If activated again within 6 seconds, it will fly to the summoned bush and receive 1 stack of Firefly Power.
“Thicket of Light”: 1 second after summoning the Thicket of Light, it releases fireflies every second towards 5 nearby heroes. Each firefly deals 100 (100 + 20% of Magical Attack + 3% of additional maximum HP) magic damage or restores 60 (60 + 10% of Magical Attack + 1.5% of additional maximum HP) HP to an ally hero. When an enemy unit enters a bush of light, it gains vision of that hero. Fireflies caused by bushes of light will no longer appear when they are about to disappear. After the light bush disappears, it becomes a normal bush for 30 seconds.

strategy.earlyGame: Sakeer's early game relies on safe wave clear and utilizing his long-range poke to whittle down opponents. Conserve your mana and focus on farming to reach your core items. Use your second skill to scout bushes and prevent early ganks from the enemy jungler.
strategy.midGame: Once you have your initial burst items, look for opportunities to combo squishy targets. Stick with your team and provide heavy area-of-effect damage during objective fights. Position yourself behind walls to surprise enemies with your full combo.
strategy.lateGame: In the late game, a single full combo from Sakeer can instantly delete any non-tank hero. Patience is vital. Wait for the enemy team to group up or step out of position. Your ultimate's massive AoE damage can completely turn the tide of a late-game teamfight.
strategy.teamfight: Stay in the absolute backline. Wait for your initiators to lock down the enemy, then unleash your skills into the fray. Prioritize hitting the enemy carries, and hold your mobility skill to escape if an assassin tries to dive you.
strategy.commonMistakes: Stepping too far forward to land a combo, wasting the ultimate on tanks, and lacking map awareness leading to easy flanks.

combos.title: Obliteration Combo
combos.description: Skill 2 -> Skill 1 -> Skill 3. Catch the enemy with the crowd control of Skill 2, follow up with Skill 1 for burst, and instantly drop Skill 3 for massive unmitigable area damage.

combos.title: Safe Poke
combos.description: Skill 1 -> Skill 2. A standard poking sequence during the laning phase to safely reduce the enemy's health without overcommitting.

synergy.reason: Continuous recovery and protection can greatly increase the survival rate against high-firepower marksmen with low mobility.
Against tanks that continue to fight on the front lines, its high recovery power can raise its practical durability to the maximum.

counters.reason: His movement was blocked by a powerful restraint skill, and he was unable to make use of his mobility to escape by flying over a wall.
Due to the high burst damage, there is a risk of being killed instantly before you can use recovery or escape skills.

strengths: His strength is his extremely versatile support ability, which can heal allies, damage enemies, Knockup enemies, and even nullify stealth and secure visibility. Passive and skill fireflies automatically track the target, allowing for stable support. With the ability to move between bushes with Skill 2 and the summoning of bushes with Skill 3, it has extremely high mobility and survival ability that utilizes the terrain of the map, and has area domination in local battles.
weaknesses: In order to maximize the effect of the main skill 1, it is necessary to accumulate stacks of "Firefly Power" over time, and it is not possible to fire powerful skills continuously. Also, because some of his mobility and support abilities depend on "thickets," skill 3 is on cooldown and he is not good at fighting in open areas with no surrounding bushes. It is weak against instantaneous burst damage and powerful hard CC, and its weakness is that it is highly dependent on allies.

passive.name: splash gradient
passive.description:
All skills are considered starting skills. When you hit an enemy with any skill, the next skill you fire will be strengthened as an additional move, and you will receive 1 stack of Engraving for 4 seconds (up to 5 stacks).
When stacked 3 times, the next Basic Attack will be strengthened to the additional technique "Splash Gradation". Charges towards the enemy and attacks 7 times, dealing 121 (80 + 25% of physical attack) physical damage each time and reducing the enemy's movement speed by 10%. The final damage deals physical damage equal to 12% of the target's missing maximum HP. Gain a 21% to 35% damage reduction effect while using enhanced normal attacks.
The additional skill inflicts a disabling effect on the enemy hit, and each stack reduces the enemy's attack speed by 10% to 20% for 4 seconds (maximum 2 stacks). Enemies remove one stack of disabling effects each time they perform a Basic Attack.

skill1.name: try slash
skill1.description: Starting technique: Fires a try slash in the specified direction, and after a certain period of time, deals 366 (200 + 100% of physical attack) physical damage to enemies along the route. When Trislash hits an enemy, Rose Swordsman's movement speed increases by 80%. This effect reverts over 2 seconds.

forms.description: Starting technique: Fires a try slash in the specified direction, and after a certain period of time, deals 366 (200 + 100% of physical attack) physical damage to enemies along the route. When Trislash hits an enemy, Rose Swordsman's movement speed increases by 80%. This effect reverts over 2 seconds.

Additional technique: Rapidly fires a try slash in the specified direction, and after a shorter time lag than the starting technique, deals 475 (260 + 130% of physical attack) physical damage to enemies along the route. When Trislash hits an enemy, Rose Swordsman's movement speed increases by 80%. This effect reverts over 2 seconds.

skill2.name: splash fant
skill2.description: Starting technique: Rush in the specified direction and quickly stab 6 times. Deals 69 (45 + 15% of physical attack) physical damage to the enemy hit each time, and recovers own HP by 70 (70 + 1% of additional maximum HP).

forms.description: Starting technique: Rush in the specified direction and quickly stab 6 times. Deals 69 (45 + 15% of physical attack) physical damage to the enemy hit each time, and recovers own HP by 70 (70 + 1% of additional maximum HP).

Additional skill: Rush in the specified direction and quickly stab 6 times. Deals 69 (45 + 15% of physical attack) physical damage to the enemy hit each time, and restores own maximum HP by 70 (70 + 1% of maximum HP). Cooldown is shorter than the starting move.

skill3.name: power gradation
skill3.description:
Starting technique: Draws 7 sword marks on the spot and attacks nearby enemies up to 3 times, dealing 320 (320 + 75% of Extra Physical Attack) physical damage each time and reducing movement speed by 25% for 1 second. While the skill is active, you will gain super armor status and a passive effect that reduces damage taken.
If you damage an enemy multiple times, the damage from the second time onwards will be reduced to 30%.

forms.description:
Starting technique: Draws 7 sword marks on the spot and attacks nearby enemies up to 3 times, dealing 320 (320 + 75% of Extra Physical Attack) physical damage each time and reducing movement speed by 25% for 1 second. While the skill is active, you will gain super armor status and a passive effect that reduces damage taken.
If you damage an enemy multiple times, the damage from the second time onwards will be reduced to 30%.

Additional technique: Quickly draws 7 sword marks on the spot (skill activation speed is faster than the starting technique), attacks nearby enemies up to 3 times, deals 320 (320 + 75% of physical attack) physical damage each time, and reduces movement speed by 25% for 1 second.
If you damage an enemy multiple times, the damage from the second time onwards will be reduced to 30%.
After completing the sword formation, activate "Power Gradation" and deal the same amount of damage again to the enemy in the center of the sword mark, knocking them up for 0.75 seconds. While the skill is active, you will gain super armor status and a passive effect that reduces damage taken.

strategy.earlyGame: Charlotte's laning phase revolves around stacking her passive by landing consecutive skills. Focus on short trades using your movement speed buffs to weave in and out. Do not commit to a sustained fight until you have fully stacked your Seven-Star Sword aura to unleash the true damage execution.
strategy.midGame: With max cooldown reduction, you become a relentless duelist. Look for side lane isolated fights where your constant damage reduction and self-healing make you unbeatable 1v1. Shove waves quickly and rotate to flank enemies during mid-game skirmishes.
strategy.lateGame: Your ability to shred tanks and assassinate carries is exceptional. Wait for the primary engage, then dive the backline. Keep track of your skill hits; missing a skill breaks your combo and resets your passive, leaving you vulnerable in a late-game 5v5.
strategy.teamfight: Do not frontline. Enter the fight slightly delayed and target the enemy marksman or mage. Continuously chain your skills to maintain your damage reduction and crowd control immunity during the Seven-Star Sword animation. Stay sticky and execute low-health targets.
strategy.commonMistakes: Missing skillshots causing the passive combo to break, engaging without any passive stacks prepped, and building pure damage instead of necessary bruiser items.

combos.title: Seven-Star Execution
combos.description: Skill 1 -> Skill 2 -> Skill 3 -> Basic Attack (Enhanced). Land Skill 1 for speed, close the gap with Skill 2, knock up with Skill 3 to complete the stacks, and unleash the enhanced Seven-Star Sword basic attack.

combos.title: Sticky Pursuit
combos.description: Skill 2 -> Skill 1 -> Basic Attack (Enhanced) -> Skill 2. Use the reduced cooldowns of consecutive skill hits to continuously dash and slow the enemy, trapping them in a relentless flurry.

synergy.reason: It restrains the enemy with powerful CC, making it easy to stack passives and connect combos.
By gathering multiple enemies in one place, you can maximize area damage and recovery effects.

counters.reason: Silence forces skill combos to be interrupted and prevents stacking of passives.
Due to its high mobility and kite ability, it does not allow you to get close, and you can only deal damage from a distance.

strengths: Its biggest strengths are its flowing continuous attacks that start with a skill hit, and its enhanced Basic Attack "Splash Gradation" that increases the percentage damage and reduces the amount of damage taken. The debuff that reduces the enemy's attack speed with additional skills gives you an overwhelming advantage against heroes who usually attack. Thanks to the high recovery power of skill 2 and the super armor of skill 3, it boasts extremely high continuous combat ability and timer performance that will not be easily defeated even if it jumps into enemy territory.
weaknesses: Unless you consistently hit the enemy with your skills, you will not be able to demonstrate your true potential, so it is difficult to control, and is weak against enemies with high evasion ability or enemies that attack from a long distance. Since it relies on skill combos, if the skill activation is blocked by a silence effect, there will be nothing you can do. Also, since the disfigurement effect is canceled when the enemy performs a Basic Attack, the debuff's benefits are weakened against heroes and mages whose blows are powerful.

passive.name: Passive skill: Prayer of sentient beings
passive.description:
Normal attacks at close range have shorter attack intervals.
Gain 1 power of sentient beings for each Basic Attack (up to 6), and when the maximum is reached, you can activate Tenrai and activate an additional basic skill.
Activating the basic skill strengthens your Basic Attack, deals an additional 85 (85 + 35% of physical attack) magic damage to enemies within range, and recovers 75 (75 + 1.2% of Extra HP) HP.
Long-range enhanced normal attacks deal 75% damage to units other than the target. (No special effects occur)

skill1.name: Skill 1: Lightning Inheritance
skill1.description: Transforms into a torrent of lightning and charges forward, dealing 200 (200 + 45% of physical attack) magic damage to enemies along the route and gaining 340 (340 + 5% of Extra HP) shield for 2.5 seconds.

skill2.name: Skill 2: Surrender Divine Punishment
skill2.description:
Releases the power of lightning in front of you. When reaching the maximum distance/contacting a unit, it will explode after a certain period of time, dealing 200 (200 + 45% of physical attack) magic damage and knocking it back.
The closer you are to the unit, the greater the knockback distance.

skill3.name: Skill 3: Thousand Years of Reverberation
skill3.description:
Resonating with the reverberations of a thousand years, it floats in the air and enters the lightning body inheritance state.
During the 1.5 second status change, you gain super armor status, increasing your movement speed by 30% and ignoring terrain. In addition, Vajra uses Vajra to randomly strike nearby enemies (hero priority), dealing 100 (100 + 22% of physical attack) magic damage, gaining 1 sentient power, and gaining 160 (160 + 2.5% of Extra HP) shield for 2 seconds. After landing, deals 200 (200 + 45% of physical attack) magic damage to nearby enemies.
The transformed state lasts for 8 seconds. During this time, the range of enhanced normal attacks increases, and normal attacks gain 2 sentient powers. Long-range normal attacks have a chain bolt effect that bounces between multiple enemies, dealing 86 (50% of physical attack) physical damage.

strategy.earlyGame: [Lane] Focus on 1v1 trades in the Clash Lane. Use close-range basic attacks to quickly stack passive energy, gaining a shield with Skill 1 and executing favorable magic damage trades with enhanced basic attacks. Dominate your lane early to start snowballing the game!
strategy.midGame: Utilize Skill 2 close-range knockback to deny enemy Clash laners or ganking assassins. Push the lane with high sustained magic damage and dominate objectives. Coordinate with your team to extend your lead!
strategy.lateGame: In late teamfights, unleash Skill 3 (Ultimate) to ignore terrain and gain Super Armor, diving directly into the enemy backline carries with automatic lightning strikes and shield generation. Catch out-of-position enemies and delete them instantly!
strategy.teamfight: Build passive stacks before entering teamfights. Use Ultimate to bypass frontline tanks, dive enemy marksmen/mages, and rotate skills rapidly with doubled stack gains. Focus the right targets and dominate the teamfight!
strategy.commonMistakes: Engaging 1v1 trades without passive stacks leads to low damage and missing shields. Avoid diving too deep with Ultimate terrain ignore if allies cannot follow up.

strengths: Its biggest strengths are its ability to take advantage of additional skill activation through passives, as well as its continuous damage and recovery ability through enhanced normal attacks. He has high durability because he can obtain a shield with skill 1 and skill 3, and is excellent at maintaining the front line as a fighter. The terrain-ignoring mobility and super armor provided by Skill 3 allow you to engage the enemy by surprise or make sure to escape, making it extremely influential in teamfights.
weaknesses: Its weakness is that it needs to be hit with regular attacks many times in order to accumulate the "power of sentient beings", and its strengths cannot be demonstrated if it is stopped by a CC (action interference) skill. Also, the knockback of skill 2 is more effective the closer you are to the enemy, so you will be at a disadvantage against enemies who mainly use poke attacks from a distance because you are more likely to take damage before you get close. The combat ability is relatively low when Skill 3 is on cooldown, so timing of engagement is important.

passive.name: Resonance/Burning
passive.description:
Communicate with the divine spear "Kasuka" and gain 1 stack of resonance when the skill is activated. Consumes all stacks during a Basic Attack, activates the resonance skills ``Firmness - Battle Stop'', ``Eagerness - Breaking Castle'', and ``True Intention - Ryohara'' depending on the number of stacks, and shortens the Cooldown of ``Datsuki'' and ``Oigumo'' by 1.5 seconds.
Resonance skills can be critical hits. Activation speed increases according to own attack speed (reflection rate 50%).

skill1.name: Dangetsu
skill1.description: Raise the spear forward and then swing it down. Deals 180 (180 + 60% of Extra Physical Attack) physical damage (2 times in total) and knocks up for 0.5 seconds when thrusting up.

forms.description: Raise the spear forward and then swing it down. Deals 180 (180 + 60% of Extra Physical Attack) physical damage (2 times in total) and knocks up for 0.5 seconds when thrusting up.

Performs continuous attacks with a spear. Increases movement speed by 25 for 1 second, deals 124 (55 + 40% of physical attack) physical damage to enemies (4 times total), and also gains 260 (260 + 4.5% of Extra HP) shield (for 2 seconds).
Activates with Basic Attack when resonance stacks 1.

skill2.name: Oigumo
skill2.description: Raise your spear, charge, and charge (maximum movement speed increased by 25%). After charging, charge forward and mow down the enemy, dealing 180 (180 + 60% of Extra Physical Attack) to 360 (360 + 120% of Extra Physical Attack) physical damage and reducing movement speed by 15% for 1 second.

forms.description: Raise your spear, charge and charge (maximum movement speed increased by 25%). After charging, charge forward and mow down the enemy, dealing 180 (180 + 60% of Extra Physical Attack) to 360 (360 + 120% of Extra Physical Attack) physical damage and reducing movement speed by 15% for 1 second.

Performs three consecutive attacks. The first two attacks each deal 129 (60 + 40% of physical attack) physical damage to the enemy and restore 90 HP (90 + 1.3% of Extra HP). The final attack deals 258 (120 + 80% of physical attack) physical damage and restores 180 HP (180 + 2.5% of Extra HP).
Activates with Basic Attack when resonance stacks 2. The lower the HP, the more the recovery amount will be (up to 2x).

skill3.name: Oisei
skill3.description:
Fills the tip of the spear with flame and moves it back and forth towards the front area, dealing 180 (180 + 60% of Extra Physical Attack) physical damage each time and knocking it up.
When the maximum distance is reached, it will pierce continuously, dealing 90 (90 + 30% of Extra Physical Attack) physical damage each time (4 times in total).
While the skill is active, you will be in a super armor state, reducing damage taken by 30%, and can activate the second stage skill "Roar of Spears" which mowing down and burning the front.
Scrape deals 180 (180 + 60% of Extra Physical Attack) physical damage, and Burning Area deals 50 (50 + 16% of Extra Physical Attack) magic damage once every 0.2 seconds for 3 seconds.
The second stage can be activated while "Tracing Star" is activated. Mows down the surrounding area, cancels the subsequent charge, deals 120 (120 + 40% of Extra Physical Attack) physical damage, and burns a circular area for 3 seconds.

forms.description:
Fills the tip of the spear with flame and moves it back and forth towards the front area, dealing 180 (180 + 60% of Extra Physical Attack) physical damage each time and knocking it up.
When the maximum distance is reached, it will pierce continuously, dealing 90 (90 + 30% of Extra Physical Attack) physical damage each time (4 times in total).
While the skill is active, you will be in a super armor state, reducing damage taken by 30%, and can activate the second stage skill "Roar of Spears" which mowing down and burning the front.
Scrape deals 180 (180 + 60% of Extra Physical Attack) physical damage, and Burning Area deals 50 (50 + 16% of Extra Physical Attack) magic damage once every 0.2 seconds for 3 seconds.
The second stage can be activated while "Tracing Star" is activated. Mows down the surrounding area, cancels the subsequent charge, deals 120 (120 + 40% of Extra Physical Attack) physical damage, and burns a circular area for 3 seconds.

After jumping into the air and gathering strength, it unleashes a ferocious blow. Deals 333 (160 + 100% of physical attack) physical damage to enemies on the route (damage increases as the target's HP is lower). The damage is maximized when the target's HP falls below 50%, dealing 666 (320 + 200% of physical attack) physical damage.
If you attack normally with 3 resonance stacks, you can ignore the terrain while jumping up. Additionally, movement speed increases by 200% and damage taken is reduced by 10%.

strategy.earlyGame: Yunying's strength lies in her flexible passive spear techniques. Clear your jungle efficiently by utilizing the first passive stack for AoE damage and shielding. Look to counter-gank early, as her sustained damage and disruptiveness can easily turn early 2v2 skirmishes.
strategy.midGame: Control the map with your excellent mobility and dueling potential. Use your second passive stack to stick to high-priority targets and heal. Secure objectives with your team, using your ultimate's massive crowd control to zone the enemy jungler away from the pit.
strategy.lateGame: You are a potent initiator and secondary tank. Wait for an opening to catch multiple enemies with your ultimate. Your third passive stack (True Intention) deals execute true damage, making you incredibly deadly to targets trying to flee low on health.
strategy.teamfight: Initiate with your ultimate to disrupt the enemy formation. Adjust your combo based on the situation: use 1-stack for shielding and AoE, 2-stacks to stick to the marksman, and 3-stacks to snipe low-health targets. Stay in the thick of the fight and absorb pressure.
strategy.commonMistakes: Mashing buttons and using the wrong passive stack for the situation, completely missing the ultimate, and engaging too far away from team support.

combos.title: True Intention Execute
combos.description: Skill 2 -> Skill 1 -> Skill 3 -> Basic Attack. Use all three skills in rapid succession to max out your spear intention, then release the enhanced basic attack to deal massive true damage execution from afar.

combos.title: Relentless Pursuit
combos.description: Skill 2 -> Basic Attack -> Skill 1 -> Basic Attack. Use the two-stack passive for rapid thrusts that heal you and close the gap, repeating to stick onto mobile targets.

synergy.reason: This is because you can control the enemy, create a reliable opening, and create a situation where you can start a combo from a dive.
It provides shielding and protection, greatly increasing your chances of survival when diving deep into enemy lines.

counters.reason: Because it has its own CC release ability and stun, it can easily counterattack divers.
Their high mobility keeps them at a distance, and their high firepower burst damage cuts them down before they can get close.

strengths: Its strength is that it can be used flexibly to suit the situation, with a variety of enhanced normal attacks depending on the number of times the skill is used. Since the cooldown of skills is shortened by the activation of enhanced normal attacks, it is very time-consuming and has excellent continuous combat ability. His ability to initiate and survive in teamfights is extremely high due to multiple knock-ups from Skill 1 and Skill 3, super armor and damage reduction effect while Skill 3 is activated.
weaknesses: It is extremely difficult to operate as it requires the management of multiple skill combos and resonance stacks, and the player's skill level is directly linked to performance. Since he is the type to compete based on the number of moves he can make, his instantaneous burst damage is slightly lower than that of the Assassin. Additionally, while your powerful skill 3 is on cooldown, your influence in teamfights decreases, so if your enemy avoids your skill or you are blocked by strong CC before it is activated, you will not be able to demonstrate your original tenacity and will be defeated.

passive.name: Passive Skill: Gyokuxing/Star Eye
passive.description:
Can move on walls, and normal attacks become long-range attacks (can also be activated while jumping).
The following effects are applied on the wall.
Gyokuxing: Increases Fei's charge speed by 10%
Star Eye: Increases visibility by 15%
CC Penalty: Movement speed reduction/CC time +25% granted on walls

skill1.name: Skill 1: Magadama/Tengeki
skill1.description:
Moves using the ball as a stepping stone, dealing 360 (360 + 110% of Extra Physical Attack) physical damage to enemies along the route and knocking them up for 0.75 seconds. Also increases own attack speed by 50% and strengthens the next 3 normal attacks.
Close range: Deals an additional 75 (75 + 20% of Extra Physical Attack) physical damage and recovers own HP by 155 (155 + 1.5% of additional maximum HP) each time.
Long range: Deals an additional 50 (50 + 13% of Extra Physical Attack) physical damage each time. After hitting, knock away the nearest unit within range.

skill2.name: Skill 2: Stepping Ball/Hibio
skill2.description:
Step Ball: Jump from the ground to the specified wall. Jump distance increases by 4% with each level up.
Flying: Jumps freely from wall to wall, toying with the opponent.
You can stack 1 stack of ``Tread Ball/Higai'' every 10 seconds (up to 4 stacks).

skill3.name: Skill 3: Seal of condensed ball
skill3.description:
Mows down the enemy with the jade blade, inflicting 270 (270 + 80% of Extra Physical Attack) physical damage, inflicts a stamp on all targets (on the wall, you can activate a coagulate mark with a movement effect), and becomes able to activate a "curd jade attack".
"Coagulant Attack": Explodes the engraving with the sword, dealing 160 (160 + 50% of Extra Physical Attack) physical damage to each target. This attack negates the untargetable state. If the target's HP is 1/8 or less, you can always destroy the enemy by turning it into a ball.

strategy.earlyGame: Harold dominates the laning phase with his immense sustain and bulk. Play aggressively, using your abilities to clear the wave while simultaneously harassing the enemy laner. Control the scuttle crab and secure deep vision in the enemy jungle.
strategy.midGame: Become the frontline juggernaut for your team. Force skirmishes around objectives, using your crowd control to lock down priority targets. Your innate tankiness allows you to absorb significant damage, creating space for your carries to output their damage safely.
strategy.lateGame: In late-game teamfights, you are the immovable object. Position yourself at the very front to absorb enemy poke and engage tools. Use your ultimate to completely disrupt the enemy formation and isolate their damage dealers.
strategy.teamfight: Dive straight into the enemy team and wreak havoc. Your goal is to draw as much attention and cooldowns as possible. Stick to the enemy marksman or mage and prevent them from participating in the fight. Trust your innate durability and healing to keep you alive.
strategy.commonMistakes: Playing too passively during the strong early game, failing to peel for your carries when necessary, and diving without your team in position to follow up.

combos.title: Vanguard's Charge
combos.description: Skill 3 -> Skill 1 -> Skill 2 -> Basic Attacks. Initiate with your massive ultimate crowd control, follow up with Skill 1 for damage, and use Skill 2 to slow and stick to the escaping targets.

combos.title: Bulwark Trade
combos.description: Skill 1 -> Basic Attack -> Skill 2. A simple but highly effective laning combo to deal damage, mitigate incoming retaliation, and out-sustain the opponent.

synergy.reason: In teamfights, it absorbs the enemy's attention and CC skills, allowing you to safely intervene in battle.
It breaks up enemy formations on the front lines, making it easy to aim at isolated enemies or soft targets in the rear.

counters.reason: Targeted hard CC will surely stop the movement and completely neutralize high mobility such as wall movement.
A strong suppression effect can stop a surprise attack and cause the enemy to focus on you.

strengths: His greatest strength is his passive ability to move freely through walls and skill 2, allowing him to surprise attacks from routes that other heroes cannot and his overwhelming mobility. In addition to the ability to secure a wide field of view from the top of the wall, skill 3's execution ability, which can nullify the untargetable state and kill enemies with HP 1/8 or less without any questions asked, poses a great threat to the enemy. By using Skill 1's launch and enhanced normal attacks, you can engage in flexible battles at short and long range depending on the situation.
weaknesses: If you receive CC while on a wall, the effect time will be extended due to the penalty, so your ability to deal with enemies with hard CC will be extremely limited. Since it specializes in mobility, its own durability is low, and it is extremely weak in situations where it fights head-on in ground combat. Also, in order to take advantage of the execution effect of powerful skill 3, allies need to reduce the enemy's HP in advance, and they do not have the continuous firepower to reduce the enemy's HP by themselves.

passive.name: little fire hawk
passive.description:
Normal attacks fire bullets with area damage and additionally deal physical damage equal to 0.5% of the target's maximum HP. When attacking on the ground, cannonballs are blocked by enemy heroes.
I'll make it work no matter what - I'm Captain Firehawk!

skill1.name: Temporary reinforcement bullet
skill1.description:
Loads reinforced shells and strengthens the next three normal attacks. Enhanced normal attacks have a larger area attack effect, dealing 180 (180 + 40% of Extra Physical Attack) physical damage to the target and Extra Physical Attack damage of 1% of the target's maximum HP.
--Part of the cost of the enhanced bullets created by Captain Firehawk is covered by the help of the indomitable mechanical arm, but unfortunately the budget is limited.

skill2.name: Meet the legendary heroes!
skill2.description:
Throw a smoke bomb and set up a smoke screen. You and your allies inside the smokescreen gain stealth for 3.5 seconds. At the same time, you will ride the explosive air current, greatly increasing your movement speed for 0.8 seconds. While in the air, you can move, attack normally, activate skills, and ignore terrain. You can extend your flight time by using normal attacks and skill 3 while in the air.
When skill 2 is activated in the air, smoke bombs will not be fired, but normal attacks will not be blocked by the enemy.
-- "Let's surprise them!" Firehawk's appearance was created by Captain Firehawk himself.

skill3.name: Rakuyo Sea fireworks show
skill3.description:
Jump high into the air, become super armored for a period of time, and fire 5 missiles at each enemy hero you lock onto. Each time the missile explodes, it deals 350 (350 + 80% of Extra Physical Attack) physical damage to enemies within range, and Extra Physical Attack damage equal to 6% of the target's lost HP. If you hit the same target multiple times, the damage from the second shot onwards will be reduced to 25%. Also, an enemy hero other than the target can receive one shot instead.
-- "Do you want to see fireworks? Or... would you like to become a firework?" Alessio asks.

strategy.earlyGame: Alessio's laning phase is about safe farming and explosive trades. Utilize your range advantage and splash damage to push the wave and poke enemies behind minions. Use your second skill's vertical mobility to dodge critical skillshots and reposition defensively.
strategy.midGame: Stick to your team and look for opportunities to unleash your massive area-of-effect damage. Your smoke screen is a vital utility tool; use it to hide yourself and your allies during rotations or objective takes. Stay safe and farm your core critical strike items.
strategy.lateGame: You are a high-value target with immense destructive power. Position meticulously. When the teamfight erupts, use your aerial vantage point to rain down damage on clustered enemies. A well-placed ultimate can decimate the enemy team in seconds.
strategy.teamfight: Stay behind your frontline and use your enhanced basic attacks to deal splash damage. When engaged upon, use Skill 2 to leap into the air, becoming untargetable by ground-based crowd control, and activate your ultimate to rain missiles on the primary threats while remaining out of reach.
strategy.commonMistakes: Using Skill 2 aggressively and having no escape when flanked, misplacing the smoke screen, and getting caught out of position before taking flight.

combos.title: Death from Above
combos.description: Skill 1 -> Skill 2 -> Skill 3 -> Basic Attacks. Enhance your attacks with Skill 1, leap into the air with Skill 2 for safety, unleash your devastating ultimate, and finish off stragglers with airborne basic attacks.

combos.title: Smoke and Mirrors
combos.description: Skill 2 -> Skill 1 -> Basic Attack. Drop the smoke screen for stealth, activate your enhanced attacks, and fire massive splash damage rockets from the cover of the smoke.

synergy.reason: This is to extend Alessio's damage output time in the air while protecting him with a shield.
By gathering the enemies in one spot, you can make the most of Alessio's normal attacks that deal area damage.

counters.reason: They have high mobility and burst damage, and can be quickly defeated before they can escape.
Because it has high instantaneous burst damage and can easily break Alessio's positioning.

strengths: Its strength is that it can exert high firepower even against tanks, since its normal attacks deal area damage and maximum HP percentage damage. Skill 2's smokescreen stealth and aerial movement that ignores the terrain allow for overwhelming survivability and free positioning. Attacks from the air can ignore enemy blocks, allowing you to accurately target the enemy's rear guard. With his skill 3 super armor and missile attacks based on the amount of HP he loses, he is also very capable as a finisher.
weaknesses: Since much of its mobility relies on aerial movement, it is vulnerable in ground battles where Skills 2 and 3 are on cooldown, making it difficult to escape. Its weakness is that its regular attacks on the ground are easily blocked by the enemy frontline, making it difficult to concentrate damage on the intended target. Also, since skill 3 missiles can be received by other enemy heroes in your place, you may not be able to defeat the target enemy during a melee.

passive.name: Serpent Flame Messenger
passive.description:
Slash the enemy with the Engetsuto during a Basic Attack. Engetsuto continues to cut enemies for 6 seconds, inflicting physical damage on each hit and reducing the Cooldown of Skill 1 by up to 0.15 seconds.
Engetsuto's attacks have a special effect of 30% of normal attacks, and you can gain visibility of the enemy you cut.
A maximum of two Engetsutos can be stacked.

skill1.name: blood fang
skill1.description: Summons one Engetsuto and increases own movement speed by 45% (decreases over 2 seconds). When attacking, Engetsuto cuts the target continuously for 6 seconds, dealing 74 (40 + 20% of physical attack) physical damage each time. While the skill is active, you can jump over walls. The cutting speed of the Engetsuto increases by up to 25% depending on the level.

skill2.name: snake kiss
skill2.description:
Summons Fire Snake to the specified location. After a certain period of time, Fire Snake will charge towards itself, dealing 320 (320 + 80% of Extra Physical Attack) magic damage to enemies along its path and reducing their movement speed by 25% for 2 seconds.
If Firesnake owns the Engetsuto, the enemy hit by the Firesnake will be cut by the Engetsuto.
If Firesnake does not own the Engetsuto, the Cooldown of Skill 2 will be reduced by 50%.
The activation motion of this skill becomes shorter as the attack speed increases.

skill3.name: blazing glare
skill3.description:
Fires a fire snake in the specified direction, dealing 480 (480 + 120% of Extra Physical Attack) magic damage to enemies along the route and inflicting blindness for 2 seconds.
Immediately summons one Engetsuto and strengthens itself for 6 seconds. During the enhancement period, energy is accumulated when attacking or being attacked by an enemy, and each time energy reaches the upper limit, it deals 240 (240 + 60% of Extra Physical Attack) magic damage to enemies within range and knocks them up for 0.5 seconds.
Enemies affected by the blinding effect can no longer be damaged by normal attacks, and projectiles when activating skills will randomly deviate from the target.

strategy.earlyGame: In the early stages, take advantage of the passive effect and the continuous cutting damage of the Engetsuto from Skill 1 to take control of the lane. Use a Basic Attack to inflict Engetsuto on the enemy and harass them unilaterally while maintaining your visibility. When skill 1 is activated, your movement speed increases by 45% and you can cross walls, allowing you to avoid enemy attacks and trade damage from a safe position. The Engetsuto attack reduces the cooldown of Skill 1, so it is important to constantly slash the enemy.
strategy.midGame: In the mid-game, he uses his skill 2, Fire Snake, to control and slow the fight, giving him an advantage in mid-range battles. Hit the enemy with a snake that charges toward you from a specified position to stop them, then combine it with the Engetsuto to deal continuous damage. The cooldown will be halved if you use Skill 2 without the Engetsuto, so the key is to use it appropriately depending on the situation. passive.description: Moving reduces skill cooldowns and restores Mana. Gains +25 Movement Speed when near ally heroes.

skill1.name: Skill 1: Tempest Field
skill1.description: Summons a wind circle at the target location for 4s (ticks every 0.5s). Deals 160 (+28% AP) magical damage to enemies and slows them by 5% (up to 5 stacks). Increases ally movement speed by 5% (up to 5 stacks).

skill2.name: Skill 2: Wind Shield
skill2.description: Fires a wind orb forward (dashes backward), gaining a 400 (+6% AP) shield and +75 Movement Speed for 2s. Deals 300 (+50% AP) magical damage to enemies and grants allies hit a 400 shield. Moves Skill 1's field if contacted.

skill3.name: Skill 3: Spring Wind Barrier
skill3.description: Creates a wind barrier around herself for 4s, knocking back nearby enemies and dealing 300 (+50% AP) magical damage and 1.25s stun upon contact. Grants allies inside the barrier Super Armor (CC immunity).

strategy.earlyGame: Use Skill 1 to speed up wave clear in Mid lane. Roam with your jungler and shield them with Skill 2 during ganks.
strategy.midGame: Stick close to your ADC or carries. Use Skill 3 to knock back enemy assassins whenever they try to dive your backline.
strategy.lateGame: Maintain vision with your passive movement speed. Keep your allies shielded and immune to CC inside your Skill 3 barrier during objective fights.
strategy.teamfight: Stand near your carries and cast Skill 3 to knock back diving fighters/assassins, creating a safe zone with Super Armor.

passive.description: Earn 2 stacks of engraving when defeating heroes, and 1 stack when assisting/defeating monsters and minions. Once you get 3 stacks, the next skill you activate will have no cooldown.

skill1.description: Deals 362 (240 + 70% of Extra Physical Attack) physical damage to nearby enemies (damage increases by 25% for each enemy hit). Also gains a shield that absorbs 381 (250 + 75% of Extra Physical Attack attacks) damage for 2 seconds. During this time, your movement speed increases by 50% (decreases continuously).

skill2.name: flying sword
skill2.description:
Deals 333 (220 + 65% of Extra Physical Attack) physical damage to enemies along the route in the specified direction. The first enemy hit will receive 1.5x damage and have their movement speed reduced by 50% for 1.5 seconds.
If you hit an enemy, you will gain 1 stack of attacks that increase your attack speed by 25% and critical hit rate by 10% for 4 seconds. Up to 2 stacks.

skill3.name: assassin sword
skill3.description:
Jumps towards the specified target and deals 557 (400 + 90% of Extra Physical Attack) physical damage (if the target is marked, deals additional true damage of 12% of lost HP). For 4 seconds after hitting the target, reduce Basic Attack damage by 50% and imprint the target for an additional 4 seconds.
Recovers HP equal to 35% of the damage dealt while applying the stamp. If the target is defeated, the Cooldown of the secret technique will be reset.
When a Basic Attack hits a unit with an imprint, the cooldown of skills 1 and 2 is reduced by 1 second.

strategy.earlyGame: Butterfly has a fast jungle traversal speed from the beginning, and her continuous skills using the passive imprint system are powerful. Defeat monsters and collect 3 stacks of engravings, then head to the gank and use skills with no cooldowns to deal massive damage to your enemies. By using skill 1's shield and movement speed increase to quickly approach enemies, and skill 2's slowing effect to block escape routes, you can aim for a sure kill from the beginning.
strategy.midGame: In the middle stages, you will gain kills and assists, accumulate passive stamps, and demonstrate your strengths as an assassin aiming for consecutive kills. Use skill 3 to jump into the enemy and forcefully continue the battle by using the effect of recovering 35% of the damage dealt during the duration of the stamp given to the target. The cooldown of the special technique is reset when a kill occurs with skill 3, so it is important to aim at the enemies whose HP has decreased one after another and collapse the enemy camp.
strategy.lateGame: In teamfights in the final stages, you will need to be able to reliably take down enemy carries (firepower) and targets with low HP. If you take the lead carelessly, you will be hit with a barrage of fire, so be sure to time your allies to engage and the enemy's control skills are exhausted. Ideally, you should use skill 3 to jump into the enemy's rear line, take a kill with guaranteed damage based on the HP lost, and chain the passive and skill 3 Cooldown reset to deal with enemies in succession.
strategy.teamfight: In teamfights, always keep track of the enemy's HP status and attack from the target you can definitely kill. Skill 1 is useful during melee battles because the more enemies it hits, the more damage it deals, and the more you can acquire a shield at the same time. After jumping in with Skill 3, use your Basic Attack to hit the imprinted enemy to reduce the cooldown of Skills 1 and 2, reduce the damage of normal attacks by 50%, and recover HP to survive and disrupt the battle line.
strategy.commonMistakes: A common mistake is to recklessly charge into the enemy's camp without having enough engravings, and then be defeated without being able to do anything after using up all your skills. Also, it can be fatal if you use Skill 3 on the wrong target and jump into a tank with full HP and can't get a kill or benefit from the cooldown. Always check the number of passive stacks and the target's remaining HP, and don't forget to attack based on the chain of kill resets.

synergy.reason: Because it can give CC immunity and damage reduction, and you can aim for a chain of kill recovery without being hindered.
This is because you can stop the enemy with a long-range stun, creating an opening for Butterfly to safely jump in.

counters.reason: Because it has CC range and high durability, and can break the chain of Butterfly's skill reset.
This is because you can use your invincibility judgment and recovery to avoid Butterfly's burst damage while also counterattacking it.

strengths: His biggest strength is his ability to eliminate skill cooldowns with his passive, and his overwhelming ability to kill continuously with skill 3, which resets his secret upon kill. It boasts unparalleled strength when the enemy's HP is low, and has the explosive power to turn the tide of battle on its own. Furthermore, his ability to survive in melee is extremely high even though he is an assassin due to his skill 1's shield and skill 3's recovery and Basic Attack damage reduction effect, which is a big attraction.
weaknesses: The weakness is that if you can't get kills or assists, you won't benefit from passives, and your firepower will be significantly reduced. Additionally, he lacks the ability to engage in teamfights on his own, and his fragility is exposed when he gets caught by the enemy's CC (action interference) skills. In situations where the enemy is equipped with armor and has high HP, or where the support is protecting the target with a powerful shield, you will not be able to use your specialty kill reset, and your influence in the battle will be rapidly lost.
